name: Erdos278.periodic_count_mul
statement:
theorem periodic_count_mul (p : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (L : ℕ)
    (hp : Function.Periodic p L) (k : ℕ) :
    Nat.count p (k * L) = k * Nat.count p L
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Nat.succ_mul, Nat.count_add']
    simp only [hp.funext, ih]
    ring

name: Erdos278.periodic_count_decomposition
statement:
theorem periodic_count_decomposition (p : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (L N : ℕ)
    (hp : Function.Periodic p L) :
    Nat.count p N = (N / L) * Nat.count p L + Nat.count p (N % L)
proof:
:= by
  have hshift : (fun k => p (N / L * L + k)) = p := by
    funext k
    rw [add_comm]
    simpa using hp.nsmul (N / L) k
  conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.div_add_mod N L, Nat.mul_comm L (N / L)]
  rw [Nat.count_add, periodic_count_mul p L hp]
  simp only [hshift]

name: Erdos278.periodic_density_error
statement:
theorem periodic_density_error (p : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (hp : Function.Periodic p L) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    |(Nat.count p N : ℝ) / N - (Nat.count p L : ℝ) / L| ≤ (L : ℝ) / N
proof:
:= by
  have hLR : (0 : ℝ) < L := by exact_mod_cast hL
  have hNR : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hc : (Nat.count p N : ℝ) =
      (N / L : ℕ) * (Nat.count p L : ℝ) + (Nat.count p (N % L) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast periodic_count_decomposition p L N hp
  have hn : (N : ℝ) = (N / L : ℕ) * (L : ℝ) + (N % L : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show N = N / L * L + N % L by
      simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using (Nat.div_add_mod N L).symm)
  have hC0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Nat.count p L := by positivity
  have hCL : (Nat.count p L : ℝ) ≤ L := by exact_mod_cast Nat.count_le p (n := L)
  have hR0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Nat.count p (N % L) := by positivity
  have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (N % L : ℕ) := by positivity
  have hrL : ((N % L : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ L := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.mod_lt N hL).le
  have hRr : (Nat.count p (N % L) : ℝ) ≤ (N % L : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.count_le p (n := N % L)
  have heq : (Nat.count p N : ℝ) / N - (Nat.count p L : ℝ) / L =
      ((L : ℝ) * Nat.count p (N % L) - (N % L : ℕ) * (Nat.count p L : ℝ)) /
        ((N : ℝ) * L) := by
    field_simp
    nlinarith
  have hb : |(L : ℝ) * Nat.count p (N % L) -
      (N % L : ℕ) * (Nat.count p L : ℝ)| ≤ (L : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    apply abs_le.mpr
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  rw [heq, abs_div, abs_of_pos (mul_pos hNR hLR)]
  calc
    _ ≤ (L : ℝ)^2 / ((N : ℝ) * L) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hb (by positivity)
    _ = (L : ℝ) / N := by field_simp

name: Erdos278.periodic_density_tendsto
statement:
theorem periodic_density_tendsto (p : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (hp : Function.Periodic p L) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (Nat.count p N : ℝ) / N) atTop
      (𝓝 ((Nat.count p L : ℝ) / L))
proof:
:= by
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((L : ℝ) / ε)
  refine ⟨max N 1, fun k hk => ?_⟩
  have hkpos : 0 < k := by omega
  have hkR : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hkpos
  have hNk : (N : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast (le_trans (le_max_left N 1) hk)
  have hbound : (L : ℝ) / k < ε := by
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ hkR).mpr
    have := (div_lt_iff₀ hε).mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hN hNk)
    nlinarith
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (periodic_density_error p L hL hp k hkpos) hbound

name: Erdos278.coveredNat_periodic
statement:
theorem coveredNat_periodic (s : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℕ) (a : ι → ℤ) :
    Function.Periodic (CoveredNat s n a) (s.lcm n)
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  apply propext
  have hc (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ s) :
      ((k + s.lcm n : ℕ) : ℤ) ≡ (k : ℤ) [ZMOD n i] := by
    apply Int.modEq_iff_dvd.mpr
    have hd : (n i : ℤ) ∣ (s.lcm n : ℕ) :=
      Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr (Finset.dvd_lcm hi)
    simpa using dvd_neg.mpr hd
  exact ⟨fun ⟨i, hi, h⟩ => ⟨i, hi, (hc i hi).symm.trans h⟩,
    fun ⟨i, hi, h⟩ => ⟨i, hi, (hc i hi).trans h⟩⟩

name: Erdos278.count_coveredNat_period
statement:
theorem count_coveredNat_period (s : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℕ) (a : ι → ℤ) :
    Nat.count (CoveredNat s n a) (s.lcm n) = (coveredFinset s n a).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range]
  have heq : ((range (s.lcm n)).filter (CoveredNat s n a)).map Nat.castEmbedding =
      coveredFinset s n a := by
    ext z
    simp only [Finset.mem_map, mem_filter, mem_range, Nat.castEmbedding_apply,
      coveredFinset, mem_biUnion, residueFinset, mem_Ico, CoveredNat]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, ⟨hk, i, hi, hc⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨i, hi, ⟨Int.natCast_nonneg k, by exact_mod_cast hk⟩, hc⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, ⟨hz0, hzL⟩, hc⟩
      lift z to ℕ using hz0
      exact ⟨z, ⟨by exact_mod_cast hzL, i, hi, hc⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [← heq, card_map]

name: Erdos278.density_is_natural_density
statement:
theorem density_is_natural_density (s : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < n i) (a : ι → ℤ) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (Nat.count (CoveredNat s n a) N : ℝ) / N) atTop
      (𝓝 (density s n a : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hL : 0 < s.lcm n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    (Finset.lcm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i hi => (hn i hi).ne'))
  simpa only [count_coveredNat_period, density, Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_natCast] using
    periodic_density_tendsto (CoveredNat s n a) (s.lcm n) hL (coveredNat_periodic s n a)

name: Erdos278.compatible_iff_dvd
statement:
theorem compatible_iff_dvd (n : ι → ℕ) (a : ι → ℤ) (i j : ι) :
    Compatible n a i j ↔ ((n i).gcd (n j) : ℤ) ∣ a i - a j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Compatible, Int.modEq_comm, Int.modEq_iff_dvd]

name: Erdos278.crt_two
statement:
theorem crt_two (m n : ℕ) (a b : ℤ)
    (h : a ≡ b [ZMOD m.gcd n]) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, z ≡ a [ZMOD m] ∧ z ≡ b [ZMOD n]
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h.dvd
  refine ⟨a + m * Nat.gcdA m n * k, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply Int.modEq_iff_dvd.mpr
    refine ⟨-Nat.gcdA m n * k, ?_⟩
    ring
  · apply Int.modEq_iff_dvd.mpr
    refine ⟨Nat.gcdB m n * k, ?_⟩
    have hb := Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_ab m n
    nlinarith [congrArg (fun t : ℤ => t * k) hb]

name: Erdos278.lcm_dvd_int_iff
statement:
theorem lcm_dvd_int_iff (s : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℕ) (z : ℤ) :
    ((s.lcm n : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ z ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, (n i : ℤ) ∣ z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Int.natCast_dvd, Finset.lcm_dvd_iff]

name: Erdos278.modEq_lcm_iff
statement:
theorem modEq_lcm_iff (s : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℕ) (a b : ℤ) :
    a ≡ b [ZMOD (s.lcm n : ℕ)] ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, a ≡ b [ZMOD n i]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Int.modEq_iff_dvd, lcm_dvd_int_iff]

name: Erdos278.gcd_finset_lcm
statement:
theorem gcd_finset_lcm (s : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℕ) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : m ≠ 0) (hn : ∀ i ∈ s, n i ≠ 0) :
    m.gcd (s.lcm n) = s.lcm (fun i => m.gcd (n i))
proof:
:= by
  have hL : s.lcm n ≠ 0 := Finset.lcm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hn
  have hg : ∀ i ∈ s, m.gcd (n i) ≠ 0 :=
    fun i _ => Nat.gcd_ne_zero_left hm
  apply Nat.eq_of_factorization_eq
    (Nat.gcd_ne_zero_left hm) (Finset.lcm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hg)
  intro p
  rw [Nat.factorization_gcd hm hL, Finsupp.inf_apply,
    Finset.factorization_lcm hn, Finset.factorization_lcm hg]
  have heq : s.sup (fun i => (m.gcd (n i)).factorization p) =
      s.sup (fun i => m.factorization p ⊓ (n i).factorization p) := by
    apply Finset.sup_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [Nat.factorization_gcd hm (hn i hi), Finsupp.inf_apply]
  rw [heq]
  clear hn hL hg heq
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih => simp only [Finset.sup_insert, inf_sup_left, ih]

name: Erdos278.generalized_crt
statement:
theorem generalized_crt (s : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℕ) (a : ι → ℤ)
    (hn : ∀ i ∈ s, n i ≠ 0) :
    (∃ z, IsSolution n a s z) ↔ IsClique n a s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩ i hi j hj
    exact ((hz i hi).of_dvd (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr
      (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _))).symm.trans
        ((hz j hj).of_dvd (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _)))
  · intro h
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => exact ⟨0, by simp [IsSolution]⟩
    | @insert i s hi ih =>
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := ih (fun j hj => hn j (mem_insert_of_mem hj))
        (fun j hj k hk => h j (mem_insert_of_mem hj) k (mem_insert_of_mem hk))
      have hcompat : a i ≡ z [ZMOD (n i).gcd (s.lcm n)] := by
        rw [gcd_finset_lcm s n (n i) (hn i (mem_insert_self _ _))
          (fun j hj => hn j (mem_insert_of_mem hj)), modEq_lcm_iff]
        intro j hj
        exact (h i (mem_insert_self _ _) j (mem_insert_of_mem hj)).trans
          (((hz j hj).of_dvd (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr
            (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _))).symm)
      obtain ⟨w, hwi, hwz⟩ := crt_two (n i) (s.lcm n) (a i) z hcompat
      refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
      intro j hj
      rcases mem_insert.mp hj with rfl | hj
      · exact hwi
      · exact ((modEq_lcm_iff s n w z).mp hwz j hj).trans (hz j hj)

name: Erdos278.solution_iff_modEq_lcm
statement:
theorem solution_iff_modEq_lcm (s : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℕ) (a : ι → ℤ)
    {z : ℤ} (hz : IsSolution n a s z) (w : ℤ) :
    IsSolution n a s w ↔ w ≡ z [ZMOD (s.lcm n : ℕ)]
proof:
:= by
  rw [modEq_lcm_iff]
  exact ⟨fun hw i hi => (hw i hi).trans (hz i hi).symm,
    fun hw i hi => (hw i hi).trans (hz i hi)⟩

name: Erdos278.gcd_dvd_interaction
statement:
theorem gcd_dvd_interaction (n : ι → ℕ) {i j : ι} (h : j ≠ i) :
    (n i).gcd (n j) ∣ interactionModulus n i
proof:
:=
  Finset.dvd_lcm (by simp [h])

name: Erdos278.interaction_dvd_modulus
statement:
theorem interaction_dvd_modulus (n : ι → ℕ) (i : ι) :
    interactionModulus n i ∣ n i
proof:
:=
  Finset.lcm_dvd (fun _j _ => Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)

name: Erdos278.interaction_pos
statement:
theorem interaction_pos (n : ι → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) (i : ι) :
    0 < interactionModulus n i
proof:
:=
  Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos (interaction_dvd_modulus n i) (hn i)

name: Erdos278.interaction_eq_gcd_lcm
statement:
theorem interaction_eq_gcd_lcm (n : ι → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i, n i ≠ 0) (i : ι) :
    interactionModulus n i = (n i).gcd ((univ.erase i).lcm n)
proof:
:=
  (gcd_finset_lcm _ _ _ (hn i) (fun j _ => hn j)).symm

name: Erdos278.interaction_compression
statement:
theorem interaction_compression (n : ι → ℕ) (a b : ι → ℤ)
    (h : ∀ i, a i ≡ b i [ZMOD interactionModulus n i]) (i j : ι) :
    Compatible n a i j ↔ Compatible n b i j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j; simp [Compatible]
  have hi := (h i).of_dvd (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr
    (gcd_dvd_interaction n (Ne.symm hij)))
  have hj := (h j).of_dvd (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr
    (gcd_dvd_interaction n hij))
  rw [Nat.gcd_comm (n j) (n i)] at hj
  exact ⟨fun hab => hi.symm.trans (hab.trans hj),
    fun hab => hi.trans (hab.trans hj.symm)⟩

name: Erdos278.interaction_minimal
statement:
theorem interaction_minimal (n : ι → ℕ) (i : ι) (m : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ j, j ≠ i → ∀ x y b : ℤ, x ≡ y [ZMOD m] →
      (x ≡ b [ZMOD (n i).gcd (n j)] ↔ y ≡ b [ZMOD (n i).gcd (n j)])) :
    interactionModulus n i ∣ m
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.lcm_dvd
  intro j hj
  have hm : (0 : ℤ) ≡ m [ZMOD m] := by simp [Int.ModEq]
  have hd := (h j (mem_erase.mp hj).1 0 m 0 hm).mp (Int.ModEq.refl 0)
  exact Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mp (Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mp hd)

name: Erdos278.reduce_preserves_compatibility
statement:
theorem reduce_preserves_compatibility (n : ι → ℕ) (a : ι → ℤ) (i j : ι) :
    Compatible n (fun i => a i % n i) i j ↔ Compatible n a i j
proof:
:= by
  have hi := (Int.mod_modEq (a i) (n i)).of_dvd
    (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr (Nat.gcd_dvd_left (n i) (n j)))
  have hj := (Int.mod_modEq (a j) (n j)).of_dvd
    (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr (Nat.gcd_dvd_right (n i) (n j)))
  exact ⟨fun h => hi.symm.trans (h.trans hj),
    fun h => hi.trans (h.trans hj.symm)⟩

name: Erdos278.translate_preserves_compatibility
statement:
theorem translate_preserves_compatibility (n : ι → ℕ) (a : ι → ℤ)
    (t : ℤ) (i j : ι) :
    Compatible n (fun i => a i - t) i j ↔ Compatible n a i j
proof:
:= by
  simp [compatible_iff_dvd]

name: Erdos278.finite_separation_dp_exact
statement:
theorem finite_separation_dp_exact {r : ℕ} {C : Type*} [Fintype C]
    (choices : C → Finset (SeparationMask r)) (H : SeparationMask r) :
    H ∈ finiteSeparationDP choices ↔
      ∃ f : C → SeparationMask r, (∀ c, f c ∈ choices c) ∧
        H = univ.biUnion f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [finiteSeparationDP, separation_dp_exact]
  let enc := Fintype.equivFin C
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg, hH⟩
    let f : C → SeparationMask r := fun c => g (enc c).val
    have hf (c : C) : f c ∈ choices c := by
      have h := hg (enc c).val (enc c).isLt
      simpa [enc, f] using h
    refine ⟨f, hf, hH.trans ?_⟩
    ext e
    simp only [mem_biUnion, mem_range, mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨t, ht, he⟩
      refine ⟨enc.symm ⟨t, ht⟩, ?_⟩
      simpa [f] using he
    · rintro ⟨c, he⟩
      exact ⟨(enc c).val, (enc c).isLt, he⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, hH⟩
    let g : ℕ → SeparationMask r := fun t =>
      if ht : t < Fintype.card C then f (enc.symm ⟨t, ht⟩) else ∅
    refine ⟨g, ?_, hH.trans ?_⟩
    · intro t ht
      simpa [g, ht, enc] using hf (enc.symm ⟨t, ht⟩)
    · ext e
      simp only [mem_biUnion, mem_range, mem_univ, true_and]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨c, he⟩
        refine ⟨(enc c).val, (enc c).isLt, ?_⟩
        simpa [g] using he
      · rintro ⟨t, ht, he⟩
        exact ⟨enc.symm ⟨t, ht⟩, by simpa [g, ht] using he⟩

name: Erdos278.coordinate_dp_exact
statement:
theorem coordinate_dp_exact {r : ℕ} {C : Type*} [Fintype C]
    (hr : 0 < r) (V : C → Finset (Fin r)) (b : C → ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ c, 0 < b c) (H : SeparationMask r) :
    H ∈ finiteSeparationDP (fun c => localSeparationMasks (V c) (b c)) ↔
      ∃ u : ∀ c, Fin r → Fin (b c),
        H = univ.biUnion (fun c => separationMask (V c) (u c))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [finite_separation_dp_exact]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    have hex (c : C) := (local_masks_exact hr (hb c) (V c) (f c)).mp (hf c)
    refine ⟨fun c => Classical.choose (hex c), ?_⟩
    apply biUnion_congr rfl
    intro c _
    exact (Classical.choose_spec (hex c)).symm
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨fun c => separationMask (V c) (u c),
      fun c => (local_masks_exact hr (hb c) (V c) _).mpr ⟨u c, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: Erdos278.fiber_digits
statement:
theorem fiber_digits {P C : Type*} [Fintype C] [DecidableEq P]
    (parent : C → P) (p : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ b, Fintype.card {c : C // parent c = b} ≤ p) :
    ∃ digit : C → Fin p, Function.Injective (fun c => (parent c, digit c))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have he (b : P) : Nonempty ({c : C // parent c = b} ↪ Fin p) :=
    Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le (by simpa using h b)
  let enc (b : P) : {c : C // parent c = b} ↪ Fin p := Classical.choice (he b)
  let paired : C ↪ P × Fin p :=
    ((Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv parent).symm.toEmbedding.trans
      (Function.Embedding.sigmaMap (Function.Embedding.refl P) enc)).trans
        (Equiv.sigmaEquivProd P (Fin p)).toEmbedding
  refine ⟨fun c => (paired c).2, ?_⟩
  intro c d hcd
  exact paired.injective hcd

name: Erdos278.corrected_tower_realizability
statement:
theorem corrected_tower_realizability (B : ℕ → Type*)
    [∀ k, Fintype (B k)] [∀ k, DecidableEq (B k)] [Subsingleton (B 0)]
    (parent : ∀ k, B (k+1) → B k) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    TowerAdmissible B parent p ↔ TowerRealized B parent p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hd (k : ℕ) := fiber_digits (parent k) p (h k)
    let digit (k : ℕ) : B (k+1) → Fin p := Classical.choose (hd k)
    have hdi (k : ℕ) : Function.Injective (fun c => (parent k c, digit k c)) :=
      Classical.choose_spec (hd k)
    let code := towerCode parent digit
    have hb : ∀ k b, code k b < p^k := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => intro b; simp [code, towerCode]
      | succ k ih =>
        intro c
        have hprev := ih (parent k c)
        have hdigit := (digit k c).isLt
        have hpow : 0 < p^k := pow_pos hp k
        dsimp [code, towerCode] at *
        rw [pow_succ]
        nlinarith
    have hm : ∀ k c, code (k+1) c % p^k = code k (parent k c) := by
      intro k c
      dsimp [code, towerCode]
      rw [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (hb k (parent k c))]
    have hi : ∀ k, Function.Injective (code k) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => intro b c _; exact Subsingleton.elim b c
      | succ k ih =>
        intro b c heq
        have hmod := congrArg (fun t => t % p^k) heq
        rw [hm, hm] at hmod
        have hparent := ih hmod
        have hv : (digit k b).val = (digit k c).val := by
          have hpow : 0 < p^k := pow_pos hp k
          change code k (parent k b) + p^k * (digit k b).val =
            code k (parent k c) + p^k * (digit k c).val at heq
          rw [hparent] at heq
          nlinarith
        exact hdi k (Prod.ext hparent (Fin.ext hv))
    exact ⟨code, hb, hi, hm⟩
  · rintro ⟨code, hb, hi, hm⟩ k b
    let enc : {c : B (k+1) // parent k c = b} → Fin p := fun c =>
      ⟨code (k+1) c.1 / p^k, by
        apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (pow_pos hp k)).mpr
        simpa [pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm] using hb (k+1) c.1⟩
    have he : Function.Injective enc := by
      intro c d heq
      have hdiv : code (k+1) c.1 / p^k = code (k+1) d.1 / p^k :=
        congrArg Fin.val heq
      have hmod : code (k+1) c.1 % p^k = code (k+1) d.1 % p^k := by
        rw [hm, hm, c.2, d.2]
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply hi (k+1)
      have hc := Nat.mod_add_div (code (k+1) c.1) (p^k)
      have hd := Nat.mod_add_div (code (k+1) d.1) (p^k)
      rw [hmod, hdiv] at hc
      exact hc.symm.trans hd
    simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_injective enc he

name: Erdos278.root_capacity
statement:
theorem root_capacity (B : ℕ → Type*) [Fintype (B 1)]
    (parent : ∀ k, B (k+1) → B k) (p : ℕ)
    (h : TowerRealized B parent p) : Fintype.card (B 1) ≤ p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨code, hb, hi, _⟩ := h
  let f : B 1 → Fin p := fun b => ⟨code 1 b, by simpa using hb 1 b⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := fun _ _ h => hi 1 (congrArg Fin.val h)
  simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hinj

name: Erdos278.tower_path_residue
statement:
theorem tower_path_residue {B : ℕ → Type*} {parent : ∀ k, B (k+1) → B k}
    {p : ℕ} (code : ∀ k, B k → ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ k b, code k b < p^k)
    (hm : ∀ k c, code (k+1) c % p^k = code k (parent k c))
    (d : ℕ) (path : ∀ k, k ≤ d → B k)
    (hpath : ∀ k (hk : k+1 ≤ d), parent k (path (k+1) hk) =
      path k (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ k) hk)) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ d) :
    code d (path d le_rfl) % p^k = code k (path k hk)
proof:
:= by
  have aux : ∀ j (hkj : k ≤ j) (hjd : j ≤ d),
      code j (path j hjd) % p^k = code k (path k hk) := by
    intro j hkj
    induction j, hkj using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => intro hkd; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (hb k _)
    | succ j hkj ih =>
      intro hjd
      have hdiv : p^k ∣ p^j := pow_dvd_pow p hkj
      rw [← Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd (code (j+1) (path (j+1) hjd)) hdiv,
        hm, hpath j hjd]
      exact ih (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ j) hjd)
  exact aux d hk le_rfl

name: Erdos278.tower_paths_agree_iff
statement:
theorem tower_paths_agree_iff {B : ℕ → Type*} {parent : ∀ k, B (k+1) → B k}
    {p : ℕ} (code : ∀ k, B k → ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ k b, code k b < p^k) (hi : ∀ k, Function.Injective (code k))
    (hm : ∀ k c, code (k+1) c % p^k = code k (parent k c))
    (d e : ℕ) (path : ∀ k, k ≤ d → B k) (path' : ∀ k, k ≤ e → B k)
    (hpath : ∀ k (hk : k+1 ≤ d), parent k (path (k+1) hk) =
      path k (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ k) hk))
    (hpath' : ∀ k (hk : k+1 ≤ e), parent k (path' (k+1) hk) =
      path' k (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ k) hk))
    (k : ℕ) (hkd : k ≤ d) (hke : k ≤ e) :
    code d (path d le_rfl) ≡ code e (path' e le_rfl) [MOD p^k] ↔
      path k hkd = path' k hke
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.ModEq, tower_path_residue code hb hm d path hpath k hkd,
    tower_path_residue code hb hm e path' hpath' k hke]
  exact (hi k).eq_iff

name: Erdos278.coprime_local_gluing
statement:
theorem coprime_local_gluing {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (s : Finset α) (n : α → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i ∈ s, n i ≠ 0) (a : α → ℤ)
    (hc : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j → (n i).Coprime (n j)) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, ∀ i ∈ s, z ≡ a i [ZMOD n i]
proof:
:= by
  apply (generalized_crt s n a hn).mpr
  intro i hi j hj
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j; exact Int.ModEq.refl _
  · unfold Compatible
    rw [(hc i hi j hj hij).gcd_eq_one]
    simp [Int.ModEq]

name: Erdos278.three_blocks_cannot_fit_two_residues
statement:
theorem three_blocks_cannot_fit_two_residues :
    ¬ ∃ a : Fin 3 → Fin 2, Function.Injective a
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
  have := Fintype.card_le_of_injective a ha
  norm_num at this

name: Erdos278.sum_powerset_disjoint_union
statement:
theorem sum_powerset_disjoint_union (s t : Finset ι) (hd : Disjoint s t)
    (f : Finset ι → ℚ) :
    ∑ u ∈ (s ∪ t).powerset, f u =
      ∑ u ∈ s.powerset, ∑ v ∈ t.powerset, f (u ∪ v)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on generalizing f with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    have hit : i ∉ t := (Finset.disjoint_insert_left.mp hd).1
    have hst : Disjoint s t := (Finset.disjoint_insert_left.mp hd).2
    rw [insert_union, sum_powerset_insert (by simp [hi, hit]),
      sum_powerset_insert hi, ih hst, ih hst]
    simp only [insert_union]

name: Erdos278.cross_coprime_lcms
statement:
theorem cross_coprime_lcms (s t : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℕ)
    (hc : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ t, (n i).Coprime (n j)) :
    (s.lcm n).Coprime (t.lcm n)
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.Coprime.of_dvd (s.lcm_dvd_prod n) (t.lcm_dvd_prod n)
  rw [Nat.coprime_prod_left_iff]
  intro i hi
  rw [Nat.coprime_prod_right_iff]
  exact hc i hi

name: Erdos278.clique_union_of_cross_coprime
statement:
theorem clique_union_of_cross_coprime (s t : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℕ) (a : ι → ℤ)
    (hc : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ t, (n i).Coprime (n j)) :
    IsClique n a (s ∪ t) ↔ IsClique n a s ∧ IsClique n a t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun i hi j hj => h i (mem_union_left _ hi) j (mem_union_left _ hj),
      fun i hi j hj => h i (mem_union_right _ hi) j (mem_union_right _ hj)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hs, ht⟩ i hi j hj
    rcases mem_union.mp hi with hi | hi <;> rcases mem_union.mp hj with hj | hj
    · exact hs i hi j hj
    · unfold Compatible
      rw [(hc i hi j hj).gcd_eq_one]
      simp [Int.ModEq]
    · unfold Compatible
      rw [(hc j hj i hi).symm.gcd_eq_one]
      simp [Int.ModEq]
    · exact ht i hi j hj

name: Erdos278.uncoveredTerm_union
statement:
theorem uncoveredTerm_union (s t : Finset ι) (hd : Disjoint s t)
    (n : ι → ℕ) (a : ι → ℤ)
    (hc : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ t, (n i).Coprime (n j)) :
    uncoveredTerm n a (s ∪ t) = uncoveredTerm n a s * uncoveredTerm n a t
proof:
:= by
  have hl : (s ∪ t).lcm n = s.lcm n * t.lcm n := by
    rw [Finset.lcm_union, lcm_eq_nat_lcm, (cross_coprime_lcms s t n hc).lcm_eq_mul]
  have hcl := clique_union_of_cross_coprime s t n a hc
  unfold uncoveredTerm intersectionWeight
  rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hd, hl]
  by_cases hs : IsClique n a s <;> by_cases ht : IsClique n a t
  · have hu := hcl.mpr ⟨hs, ht⟩
    simp [hs, ht, hu, pow_add, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
  · have hu : ¬ IsClique n a (s ∪ t) := fun h => ht (hcl.mp h).2
    simp [hs, ht, hu]
  · have hu : ¬ IsClique n a (s ∪ t) := fun h => hs (hcl.mp h).1
    simp [hs, ht, hu]
  · have hu : ¬ IsClique n a (s ∪ t) := fun h => hs (hcl.mp h).1
    simp [hs, ht, hu]

name: Erdos278.uncovered_component_factorization
statement:
theorem uncovered_component_factorization (s t : Finset ι) (hd : Disjoint s t)
    (n : ι → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i ∈ s ∪ t, 0 < n i) (a : ι → ℤ)
    (hc : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ t, (n i).Coprime (n j)) :
    1 - density (s ∪ t) n a = (1 - density s n a) * (1 - density t n a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [uncovered_eq_powerset (s ∪ t) n hn a,
    uncovered_eq_powerset s n (fun i hi => hn i (mem_union_left _ hi)) a,
    uncovered_eq_powerset t n (fun i hi => hn i (mem_union_right _ hi)) a,
    sum_powerset_disjoint_union s t hd, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro u hu
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro v hv
  have hus := mem_powerset.mp hu
  have hvt := mem_powerset.mp hv
  exact uncoveredTerm_union u v (hd.mono hus hvt) n a
    (fun i hi j hj => hc i (hus hi) j (hvt hj))

name: Erdos278.density_bounds
statement:
theorem density_bounds (s : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < n i) (a : ι → ℤ) :
    0 ≤ density s n a ∧ density s n a ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hL : 0 < s.lcm n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    (Finset.lcm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i hi => (hn i hi).ne'))
  have hLR : (0 : ℚ) < (s.lcm n : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hL
  have hsub : coveredFinset s n a ⊆ Finset.Ico 0 (s.lcm n : ℕ) := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hz
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).1
  have hcard : (coveredFinset s n a).card ≤ s.lcm n := by
    simpa using Finset.card_le_card hsub
  constructor
  · exact div_nonneg (by positivity) hLR.le
  · unfold density
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hLR).mpr
    simpa using (show ((coveredFinset s n a).card : ℚ) ≤ (s.lcm n : ℕ) by exact_mod_cast hcard)

name: Erdos278.density_congr_on
statement:
theorem density_congr_on (s : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℕ) (a b : ι → ℤ)
    (hab : ∀ i ∈ s, a i = b i) : density s n a = density s n b
proof:
:= by
  have heq : coveredFinset s n a = coveredFinset s n b := by
    unfold coveredFinset
    apply Finset.biUnion_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [hab i hi]
  simp only [density, heq]

name: Erdos278.component_optima_glue
statement:
theorem component_optima_glue (s t : Finset ι) (hd : Disjoint s t)
    (n : ι → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i ∈ s ∪ t, 0 < n i)
    (hc : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ t, (n i).Coprime (n j))
    (a b : ι → ℤ)
    (ha : ∀ x, density s n x ≤ density s n a)
    (hb : ∀ x, density t n x ≤ density t n b) :
    ∃ x : ι → ℤ,
      (1 - density (s ∪ t) n x = (1 - density s n a) * (1 - density t n b)) ∧
      (∀ y, density (s ∪ t) n y ≤ density (s ∪ t) n x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let x : ι → ℤ := fun i => if i ∈ s then a i else b i
  have hxs : density s n x = density s n a :=
    density_congr_on s n x a (fun i hi => by simp [x, hi])
  have hxt : density t n x = density t n b := by
    apply density_congr_on t n x b
    intro i hi
    have his : i ∉ s := fun hs => Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd hs hi
    simp [x, his]
  have heq : 1 - density (s ∪ t) n x = (1 - density s n a) * (1 - density t n b) := by
    rw [uncovered_component_factorization s t hd n hn x hc, hxs, hxt]
  refine ⟨x, heq, fun y => ?_⟩
  have hsa := ha y
  have htb := hb y
  have hsbound := density_bounds s n (fun i hi => hn i (mem_union_left _ hi)) a
  have htbound := density_bounds t n (fun i hi => hn i (mem_union_right _ hi)) b
  have hprod : (1 - density s n a) * (1 - density t n b) ≤
      (1 - density s n y) * (1 - density t n y) :=
    mul_le_mul (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hey := uncovered_component_factorization s t hd n hn y hc
  linarith

name: Erdos278.uncovered_eq_powerset
statement:
theorem uncovered_eq_powerset (s : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < n i) (a : ι → ℤ) :
    1 - density s n a = ∑ t ∈ s.powerset, uncoveredTerm n a t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [density_eq_graphValue s n hn a]
  have hsplit := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not s.powerset
    (fun t => t.Nonempty) (uncoveredTerm n a)
  have he : ∑ t ∈ s.powerset with ¬ t.Nonempty, uncoveredTerm n a t = 1 := by
    have hfilter : s.powerset.filter (fun t => ¬t.Nonempty) = {∅} := by
      ext t
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_powerset, mem_singleton, not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty]
      exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨by rw [h]; exact empty_subset _, h⟩⟩
    rw [hfilter, sum_singleton]
    have hcl : IsClique n a ∅ := by simp [IsClique]
    simp [uncoveredTerm, intersectionWeight, hcl]
  rw [he] at hsplit
  have hmain : graphValue s n (Compatible n a) =
      - ∑ t ∈ s.powerset with t.Nonempty, uncoveredTerm n a t := by
    unfold graphValue
    rw [← Finset.sum_coe_sort (s.powerset.filter (·.Nonempty)) (uncoveredTerm n a),
      ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro t _
    unfold uncoveredTerm intersectionWeight
    by_cases hc : IsClique n a t.1
    · rw [if_pos hc]
      have hc' : ∀ i ∈ t.1, ∀ j ∈ t.1, Compatible n a i j := hc
      rw [if_pos hc']
      simp [pow_succ, div_eq_mul_inv]
    · rw [if_neg hc]
      have hc' : ¬(∀ i ∈ t.1, ∀ j ∈ t.1, Compatible n a i j) := hc
      rw [if_neg hc']
      simp
  rw [hmain]
  linarith

name: Erdos278.coprime_uncovered_product
statement:
theorem coprime_uncovered_product (s : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < n i) (a : ι → ℤ)
    (hc : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j → (n i).Coprime (n j)) :
    1 - density s n a = ∏ i ∈ s, (1 - (1 : ℚ) / n i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [uncovered_eq_powerset s n hn a, Finset.prod_sub]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro t ht
  have hts := mem_powerset.mp ht
  have hcl : IsClique n a t := by
    intro i hi j hj
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j; exact Int.ModEq.refl _
    · unfold Compatible
      rw [(hc i (hts hi) j (hts hj) hij).gcd_eq_one]
      simp [Int.ModEq]
  have hprod : t.lcm n = t.prod n :=
    Finset.lcm_eq_prod (fun i hi j hj hij => hc i (hts hi) j (hts hj) hij)
  simp [uncoveredTerm, intersectionWeight, if_pos hcl, hprod]

name: Erdos278.radix_prefix_bound
statement:
theorem radix_prefix_bound {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (u : ℕ → Fin b) (k : ℕ) :
    radixPrefix b u k < b^k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [radixPrefix]
  | succ k ih =>
    have hd := (u k).isLt
    have hp := pow_pos hb k
    simp only [radixPrefix, pow_succ]
    nlinarith

name: Erdos278.radix_prefix_step_mod
statement:
theorem radix_prefix_step_mod {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (u : ℕ → Fin b) (k : ℕ) :
    radixPrefix b u (k+1) % b^k = radixPrefix b u k
proof:
:= by
  rw [radixPrefix, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left,
    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (radix_prefix_bound hb u k)]

name: Erdos278.radix_prefix_mod
statement:
theorem radix_prefix_mod {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (u : ℕ → Fin b) {k d : ℕ} (hkd : k ≤ d) :
    radixPrefix b u d % b^k = radixPrefix b u k
proof:
:= by
  induction d, hkd using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (radix_prefix_bound hb u k)
  | succ d hkd ih =>
    rw [← Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd (radixPrefix b u (d+1)) (pow_dvd_pow b hkd),
      radix_prefix_step_mod hb, ih]

name: Erdos278.radix_prefix_eq_iff
statement:
theorem radix_prefix_eq_iff {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (u v : ℕ → Fin b) (k : ℕ) :
    radixPrefix b u k = radixPrefix b v k ↔ ∀ t < k, u t = v t
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [radixPrefix]
  | succ k ih =>
    constructor
    · intro heq
      have hp : radixPrefix b u k = radixPrefix b v k := by
        have h := congrArg (fun x => x % b^k) heq
        simpa only [radix_prefix_step_mod hb] using h
      have hd : u k = v k := by
        apply Fin.ext
        have hbpow := pow_pos hb k
        simp only [radixPrefix, hp] at heq
        nlinarith
      intro t ht
      by_cases htk : t = k
      · simpa [htk] using hd
      · exact ih.mp hp t (by omega)
    · intro h
      simp only [radixPrefix, ih.mpr (fun t ht => h t (by omega)), h k (by omega)]

name: Erdos278.radix_prefix_represents
statement:
theorem radix_prefix_represents {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (a k : ℕ) :
    ∃ u : ℕ → Fin b, radixPrefix b u k = a % b^k
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing a with
  | zero => exact ⟨fun _ => ⟨0, hb⟩, by simp only [radixPrefix, pow_zero, Nat.mod_one]⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := ih a
    let digit : Fin b := ⟨(a / b^k) % b, Nat.mod_lt _ hb⟩
    let v : ℕ → Fin b := fun t => if t = k then digit else u t
    have hv : radixPrefix b v k = radixPrefix b u k :=
      (radix_prefix_eq_iff hb v u k).mpr (fun t ht => by simp [v, ht.ne])
    refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
    rw [radixPrefix, hv, hu]
    simp only [v, ↓reduceIte, digit]
    rw [pow_succ]
    exact Nat.mod_mul.symm

name: Erdos278.radix_prefix_modEq_iff
statement:
theorem radix_prefix_modEq_iff {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (u v : ℕ → Fin b) {k d e : ℕ} (hkd : k ≤ d) (hke : k ≤ e) :
    (radixPrefix b u d : ℤ) ≡ (radixPrefix b v e : ℤ) [ZMOD b^k] ↔
      ∀ t < k, u t = v t
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : radixPrefix b u d ≡ radixPrefix b v e [MOD b^k] ↔
      ∀ t < k, u t = v t := by
    rw [Nat.ModEq, radix_prefix_mod hb u hkd, radix_prefix_mod hb v hke,
      radix_prefix_eq_iff hb]
  exact_mod_cast hnat

name: Erdos278.radix_modulus_pos
statement:
theorem radix_modulus_pos {β : Type*} [Fintype β]
    (b e : β → ℕ) (hb : ∀ j, 0 < b j) : 0 < radixModulus b e
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Finset.lcm_ne_zero_iff.mpr
    (fun j _ => pow_ne_zero _ (hb j).ne'))

name: Erdos278.radix_modulus_eq_product
statement:
theorem radix_modulus_eq_product {β : Type*} [Fintype β]
    (b e : β → ℕ) (hc : Pairwise (fun j k => (b j).Coprime (b k))) :
    radixModulus b e = ∏ j, b j ^ e j
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.lcm_eq_prod (fun j _ k _ hjk => (hc hjk).pow _ _)

name: Erdos278.radix_power_gcd
statement:
theorem radix_power_gcd (b d e : ℕ) :
    (b^d).gcd (b^e) = b^(min d e)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total d e with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_left h, Nat.gcd_eq_left (pow_dvd_pow b h)]
  · rw [min_eq_right h, Nat.gcd_eq_right (pow_dvd_pow b h)]

name: Erdos278.radix_modulus_gcd
statement:
theorem radix_modulus_gcd {β : Type*} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    (b e f : β → ℕ) (hb : ∀ j, 0 < b j)
    (hc : Pairwise (fun j k => (b j).Coprime (b k))) :
    (radixModulus b e).gcd (radixModulus b f) =
      radixModulus b (fun j => min (e j) (f j))
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.dvd_antisymm
  · change (radixModulus b e).gcd (univ.lcm (fun j => b j ^ f j)) ∣ _
    rw [gcd_finset_lcm univ _ _ (radix_modulus_pos b e hb).ne'
      (fun j _ => pow_ne_zero _ (hb j).ne')]
    apply Finset.lcm_dvd
    intro j _
    rw [Nat.gcd_comm]
    change (b j ^ f j).gcd (univ.lcm (fun k => b k ^ e k)) ∣ _
    rw [gcd_finset_lcm univ _ _
      (pow_ne_zero _ (hb j).ne') (fun k _ => pow_ne_zero _ (hb k).ne')]
    apply Finset.lcm_dvd
    intro k _
    by_cases h : j = k
    · subst k
      rw [radix_power_gcd, min_comm]
      exact Finset.dvd_lcm (mem_univ j)
    · rw [((hc h).pow _ _).gcd_eq_one]
      exact one_dvd _
  · apply Finset.lcm_dvd
    intro j _
    apply Nat.dvd_gcd
    · exact (pow_dvd_pow (b j) (min_le_left _ _)).trans
        (Finset.dvd_lcm (mem_univ j))
    · exact (pow_dvd_pow (b j) (min_le_right _ _)).trans
        (Finset.dvd_lcm (mem_univ j))

name: Erdos278.radix_digits_reconstruct
statement:
theorem radix_digits_reconstruct {r : ℕ} {β : Type*} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    (b : β → ℕ) (e : Fin r → β → ℕ) (hb : ∀ j, 0 < b j)
    (hc : Pairwise (fun j k => (b j).Coprime (b k)))
    (u : ∀ j, ℕ → Fin r → Fin (b j)) :
    ∃ a : Fin r → ℤ, ∀ i j,
      a i ≡ (radixPrefix (b j) (fun t => u j t i) (e i j) : ℤ)
        [ZMOD (b j)^(e i j)]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex (i : Fin r) := coprime_local_gluing univ
    (fun j => b j ^ e i j) (fun j _ => pow_ne_zero _ (hb j).ne')
    (fun j => (radixPrefix (b j) (fun t => u j t i) (e i j) : ℤ))
    (fun j _ k _ hjk => (hc hjk).pow _ _)
  exact ⟨fun i => Classical.choose (hex i),
    fun i j => Classical.choose_spec (hex i) j (mem_univ j)⟩

name: Erdos278.radix_compatible_iff
statement:
theorem radix_compatible_iff {r : ℕ} {β : Type*} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    (b : β → ℕ) (e : Fin r → β → ℕ) (hb : ∀ j, 0 < b j)
    (hc : Pairwise (fun j k => (b j).Coprime (b k)))
    (u : ∀ j, ℕ → Fin r → Fin (b j)) (a : Fin r → ℤ)
    (ha : ∀ i j, a i ≡ (radixPrefix (b j) (fun t => u j t i) (e i j) : ℤ)
      [ZMOD (b j)^(e i j)]) (i h : Fin r) :
    Compatible (fun i => radixModulus b (e i)) a i h ↔
      ∀ j t, t < e i j → t < e h j → u j t i = u j t h
proof:
:= by
  rw [Compatible, radix_modulus_gcd b (e i) (e h) hb hc, radixModulus,
    modEq_lcm_iff]
  have hj (j : β) :
      a i ≡ a h [ZMOD (b j)^min (e i j) (e h j)] ↔
        ∀ t < min (e i j) (e h j), u j t i = u j t h := by
    have hi := (ha i j).of_dvd (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr
      (pow_dvd_pow (b j) (min_le_left (e i j) (e h j))))
    have hh := (ha h j).of_dvd (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr
      (pow_dvd_pow (b j) (min_le_right (e i j) (e h j))))
    have heq : (a i ≡ a h [ZMOD (b j)^min (e i j) (e h j)]) ↔
        ((radixPrefix (b j) (fun t => u j t i) (e i j) : ℤ) ≡
          (radixPrefix (b j) (fun t => u j t h) (e h j) : ℤ)
            [ZMOD (b j)^min (e i j) (e h j)]) :=
      ⟨fun H => hi.symm.trans (H.trans hh), fun H => hi.trans (H.trans hh.symm)⟩
    exact heq.trans (radix_prefix_modEq_iff (hb j) _ _ (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
  simp only [mem_univ, forall_const]
  constructor
  · intro H j t hi hh
    exact (hj j).mp (H j) t (lt_min hi hh)
  · intro H j
    exact (hj j).mpr (fun t ht => H j t (lt_min_iff.mp ht).1 (lt_min_iff.mp ht).2)

name: Erdos278.radix_integer_represents
statement:
theorem radix_integer_represents {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (a : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ u : ℕ → Fin b, a ≡ (radixPrefix b u k : ℤ) [ZMOD b^k]
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (0 : ℤ) < (b^k : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast pow_pos hb k
  let x : ℕ := (a % (b^k : ℕ)).toNat
  have hx : (x : ℤ) = a % (b^k : ℕ) :=
    Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Int.emod_nonneg _ hp.ne')
  have hlt : x < b^k := by
    have hh := Int.emod_lt_of_pos a hp
    rw [← hx] at hh
    exact_mod_cast hh
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := radix_prefix_represents hb x k
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt] at hu
  rw [hu, hx]
  exact (Int.mod_modEq _ _).symm

name: Erdos278.radix_residues_encode
statement:
theorem radix_residues_encode {r : ℕ} {β : Type*} [Fintype β]
    (b : β → ℕ) (e : Fin r → β → ℕ) (hb : ∀ j, 0 < b j)
    (a : Fin r → ℤ) :
    ∃ u : ∀ j, ℕ → Fin r → Fin (b j), ∀ i j,
      a i ≡ (radixPrefix (b j) (fun t => u j t i) (e i j) : ℤ)
        [ZMOD (b j)^(e i j)]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex (i : Fin r) (j : β) := radix_integer_represents (hb j) (a i) (e i j)
  exact ⟨fun j t i => Classical.choose (hex i j) t,
    fun i j => Classical.choose_spec (hex i j)⟩

name: Erdos278.mask_graph_exact
statement:
theorem mask_graph_exact {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → ℤ) (i j : Fin r) :
    maskGraph (incompatibilityMask n a) i j ↔ Compatible n a i j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs (i j : Fin r) : Compatible n a i j ↔ Compatible n a j i := by
    simp only [Compatible, Nat.gcd_comm (n j) (n i), Int.modEq_comm]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases lt_trichotomy i j with hij | hij | hji
    · have hh := h ⟨(i,j), hij⟩ (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
      simpa [incompatibilityMask] using hh
    · subst j
      exact Int.ModEq.refl _
    · apply (hs i j).mpr
      have hh := h ⟨(j,i), hji⟩ (Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
      simpa [incompatibilityMask] using hh
  · intro h p hp
    simp only [incompatibilityMask, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, not_not]
    rcases hp with ⟨hi, hj⟩ | ⟨hj, hi⟩
    · simpa [hi, hj] using h
    · simpa [hi, hj] using (hs i j).mp h

name: Erdos278.mask_density_exact
statement:
theorem mask_density_exact {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (a : Fin r → ℤ) :
    maskDensity n (incompatibilityMask n a) = density univ n a
proof:
:= by
  rw [density_eq_graphValue univ n (fun i _ => hn i)]
  unfold maskDensity
  congr 1
  funext i j
  exact propext (mask_graph_exact n a i j)

name: Erdos278.radix_dp_density_exact
statement:
theorem radix_dp_density_exact {r : ℕ} {β : Type*} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    (hr : 0 < r) (n : Fin r → ℕ) (b : β → ℕ) (e : Fin r → β → ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ j, 0 < b j) (hc : Pairwise (fun j k => (b j).Coprime (b k)))
    (hn : ∀ i, radixModulus b (e i) = n i) (d : ℚ) :
    (∃ H ∈ radixDP b e, maskDensity n H = d) ↔
      ∃ a : Fin r → ℤ, density univ n a = d
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun i => radixModulus b (e i)) = n := funext hn
  have hpos (i : Fin r) : 0 < n i := hn i ▸ radix_modulus_pos b (e i) hb
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨H, hH, hd⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (radix_dp_realizable_exact hr b e hb hc H).mp hH
    rw [heq] at ha
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    rw [ha, mask_density_exact n hpos a] at hd
    exact hd
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨incompatibilityMask n a, ?_, mask_density_exact n hpos a⟩
    apply (radix_dp_realizable_exact hr b e hb hc _).mpr
    exact ⟨a, by rw [heq]⟩

name: Erdos278.radix_dp_maximum
statement:
theorem radix_dp_maximum {r : ℕ} {β : Type*} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    (hr : 0 < r) (n : Fin r → ℕ) (b : β → ℕ) (e : Fin r → β → ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ j, 0 < b j) (hc : Pairwise (fun j k => (b j).Coprime (b k)))
    (hn : ∀ i, radixModulus b (e i) = n i) :
    ∃ H ∈ radixDP b e, ∃ a : Fin r → ℤ,
      maskDensity n H = density univ n a ∧
      (∀ K ∈ radixDP b e, maskDensity n K ≤ maskDensity n H) ∧
      (∀ x : Fin r → ℤ, density univ n x ≤ density univ n a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex := (radix_dp_density_exact hr n b e hb hc hn (density univ n (fun _ => 0))).mpr
    ⟨fun _ => 0, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨H₀, hH₀, _⟩ := hex
  obtain ⟨H, hH, hmax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image (radixDP b e) (maskDensity n) ⟨H₀, hH₀⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (radix_dp_density_exact hr n b e hb hc hn (maskDensity n H)).mp
    ⟨H, hH, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨H, hH, a, ha.symm, hmax, ?_⟩
  intro x
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hx⟩ := (radix_dp_density_exact hr n b e hb hc hn (density univ n x)).mpr
    ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rw [← hx, ha]
  exact hmax K hK

name: Erdos278.finite_support_relabel
statement:
theorem finite_support_relabel {r b : ℕ} {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (V : Finset (Fin r)) (f : Fin r → α) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hcard : (V.image f).card ≤ b) :
    ∃ g : Fin r → Fin b,
      (∀ i ∈ V, ∀ j ∈ V, g i = g j ↔ f i = f j) ∧
      (V.image g).card = (V.image f).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T := V.image f
  obtain ⟨e⟩ : Nonempty (T ↪ Fin b) :=
    Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le (by simpa [T] using hcard)
  let g : Fin r → Fin b := fun i =>
    if hi : i ∈ V then e ⟨f i, mem_image.mpr ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩⟩ else ⟨0, hb⟩
  have hg (i : Fin r) (hi : i ∈ V) :
      g i = e ⟨f i, mem_image.mpr ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩⟩ := by simp [g, hi]
  refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi j hj
    rw [hg i hi, hg j hj, e.injective.eq_iff, Subtype.mk.injEq]
  · have himage : V.image g = (univ : Finset T).image e := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro hy
        obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hy
        exact mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨f i, mem_image.mpr ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩⟩,
          mem_univ _, (hg i hi).symm⟩
      · intro hy
        obtain ⟨z, _, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hy
        obtain ⟨i, hi, hfi⟩ := mem_image.mp z.2
        refine mem_image.mpr ⟨i, hi, ?_⟩
        rw [hg i hi]
        congr 1
        exact Subtype.ext hfi
    rw [himage, card_image_of_injective _ e.injective]
    simp [T]

name: Erdos278.separationMask_eq_of_pattern
statement:
theorem separationMask_eq_of_pattern {r : ℕ} {α β : Type*}
    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (V : Finset (Fin r))
    (f : Fin r → α) (g : Fin r → β)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ V, ∀ j ∈ V, f i = f j ↔ g i = g j) :
    separationMask V f = separationMask V g
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  simp only [separationMask, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  exact and_congr_right (fun hi => and_congr_right (fun hj => not_congr (h _ hi _ hj)))

name: Erdos278.local_masks_exact
statement:
theorem local_masks_exact {r b : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hb : 0 < b)
    (V : Finset (Fin r)) (H : SeparationMask r) :
    H ∈ localSeparationMasks V b ↔
      ∃ f : Fin r → Fin b, separationMask V f = H
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp h
    obtain ⟨f, hf, _⟩ := finite_support_relabel V c hb (mem_filter.mp hc).2
    exact ⟨f, separationMask_eq_of_pattern V f c hf⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, rfl⟩
    have hc : (V.image f).card ≤ r :=
      (card_image_le).trans (by simpa using V.card_le_univ)
    obtain ⟨c, hpat, hcard⟩ := finite_support_relabel V f hr hc
    refine mem_image.mpr ⟨c, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, ?_⟩,
      separationMask_eq_of_pattern V c f hpat⟩
    rw [hcard]
    simpa using (V.image f).card_le_univ

name: Erdos278.local_masks_card_bound
statement:
theorem local_masks_card_bound {r : ℕ} (V : Finset (Fin r)) (b : ℕ) :
    (localSeparationMasks V b).card ≤ r ^ r
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ((univ : Finset (Fin r → Fin r)).filter
        (fun f => (V.image f).card ≤ b)).card := card_image_le
    _ ≤ (univ : Finset (Fin r → Fin r)).card := card_filter_le _ _
    _ = r ^ r := by simp

name: Erdos278.separation_step_mem
statement:
theorem separation_step_mem {r : ℕ} (R T : Finset (SeparationMask r))
    (H : SeparationMask r) :
    H ∈ separationStep R T ↔ ∃ U ∈ R, ∃ V ∈ T, U ∪ V = H
proof:
:= by
  simp only [separationStep, mem_image, mem_product, Prod.exists]
  aesop

name: Erdos278.prefix_biUnion_succ
statement:
theorem prefix_biUnion_succ {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (f : ℕ → Finset α) (k : ℕ) :
    (range (k+1)).biUnion f = (range k).biUnion f ∪ f k
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.range_add_one, biUnion_insert, union_comm]

name: Erdos278.separation_dp_exact
statement:
theorem separation_dp_exact {r : ℕ} (choices : ℕ → Finset (SeparationMask r))
    (k : ℕ) (H : SeparationMask r) :
    H ∈ separationDP choices k ↔
      ∃ f : ℕ → SeparationMask r,
        (∀ t < k, f t ∈ choices t) ∧ H = (range k).biUnion f
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing H with
  | zero =>
    simp only [separationDP, mem_singleton, range_zero, biUnion_empty]
    exact ⟨fun h => ⟨fun _ => ∅, by simp, h⟩, fun ⟨_, _, h⟩ => h⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [separationDP, separation_step_mem]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨U, hU, V, hV, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := (ih U).mp hU
      let g : ℕ → SeparationMask r := fun t => if t = k then V else f t
      have hg : (range k).biUnion g = (range k).biUnion f := by
        apply biUnion_congr rfl
        intro t ht
        simp [g, (mem_range.mp ht).ne]
      refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro t ht
        by_cases he : t = k
        · subst t; simpa [g] using hV
        · simpa [g, he] using hf t (by omega)
      · rw [prefix_biUnion_succ, hg]
        simp [g]
    · rintro ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨(range k).biUnion f, (ih _).mpr ⟨f, fun t ht =>
        hf t (by omega), rfl⟩, f k, hf k (by omega), ?_⟩
      exact (prefix_biUnion_succ f k).symm

name: Erdos278.separation_mask_universe_card
statement:
theorem separation_mask_universe_card (r : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (SeparationMask r) = 2 ^ (r * (r-1) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := twice_pair_count r
  have hcard : Fintype.card (PairIndex r) = r * (r-1) / 2 := by omega
  simp [SeparationMask, Fintype.card_finset, hcard]

name: Erdos278.separation_dp_state_bound
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [separation_mask_universe_card] using (separationDP choices k).card_le_univ

name: Erdos278.separation_step_candidate_bound
statement:
theorem separation_step_candidate_bound {r : ℕ}
    (R : Finset (SeparationMask r)) (V : Finset (Fin r)) (b : ℕ) :
    (R ×ˢ localSeparationMasks V b).card ≤
      2 ^ (r * (r-1) / 2) * r ^ r
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_product]
  apply Nat.mul_le_mul
  · simpa only [separation_mask_universe_card] using R.card_le_univ
  · exact local_masks_card_bound V b

name: Erdos278.union_card_eq_iff_pairwise_disjoint
statement:
theorem union_card_eq_iff_pairwise_disjoint {ι α : Type*}
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset ι) (t : ι → Finset α) :
    (s.biUnion t).card = ∑ i ∈ s, (t i).card ↔
      ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j → Disjoint (t i) (t j)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | @insert k s hk ih =>
      intro h
      rw [Finset.biUnion_insert, Finset.sum_insert hk] at h
      have htail : (s.biUnion t).card ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (t i).card := Finset.card_biUnion_le
      have hunion := Finset.card_union_le (t k) (s.biUnion t)
      have heqtail : (s.biUnion t).card = ∑ i ∈ s, (t i).card := by omega
      have hequnion : (t k ∪ s.biUnion t).card = (t k).card + (s.biUnion t).card := by omega
      have hdis := Finset.card_union_eq_card_add_card.mp hequnion
      have hhead (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ s) : Disjoint (t k) (t i) := by
        apply hdis.mono_right
        intro x hx
        exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, hi, hx⟩
      intro i hi j hj hij
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hi with rfl | his
      · rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hj with rfl | hjs
        · exact (hij rfl).elim
        · exact hhead j hjs
      · rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hj with rfl | hjs
        · exact (hhead i his).symm
        · exact ih heqtail i his j hjs hij
  · intro h
    exact Finset.card_biUnion h

name: Erdos278.residue_disjoint_iff
statement:
theorem residue_disjoint_iff (L m n : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hm : m ∣ L) (hn : n ∣ L) (a b : ℤ) :
    Disjoint (residueFinset L m a) (residueFinset L n b) ↔
      ¬ (a ≡ b [ZMOD m.gcd n])
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hd hc
    obtain ⟨z, hzm, hzn⟩ := crt_two m n a b hc
    let w : ℤ := z % L
    have hLp : (0 : ℤ) < L := by exact_mod_cast hL
    have hwI : w ∈ Finset.Ico 0 (L : ℤ) :=
      Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨Int.emod_nonneg _ hLp.ne', Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ hLp⟩
    have hwz : w ≡ z [ZMOD L] := Int.mod_modEq _ _
    have hwm : w ∈ residueFinset L m a := Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      ⟨hwI, (hwz.of_dvd (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr hm)).trans hzm⟩
    have hwn : w ∈ residueFinset L n b := Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      ⟨hwI, (hwz.of_dvd (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr hn)).trans hzn⟩
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd hwm hwn
  · intro hc
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro w hwm hwn
    have hwma := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hwm).2
    have hwnb := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hwn).2
    exact hc ((hwma.of_dvd (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m n))).symm.trans
      (hwnb.of_dvd (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr (Nat.gcd_dvd_right m n))))

name: Erdos278.reciprocal_sum_as_card_sum
statement:
theorem reciprocal_sum_as_card_sum {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℕ) (a : ι → ℤ) (hn : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < n i)
    (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (hd : ∀ i ∈ s, n i ∣ L) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, (1 : ℚ) / n i) =
      ((∑ i ∈ s, (residueFinset L (n i) (a i)).card : ℕ) : ℚ) / L
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.cast_sum, Finset.sum_div]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  exact (residue_ratio (n i) L (hn i hi) hL (hd i hi) (a i)).symm

name: Erdos278.density_le_reciprocal_sum
statement:
theorem density_le_reciprocal_sum {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < n i) (a : ι → ℤ) :
    density s n a ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (1 : ℚ) / n i
proof:
:= by
  have hL : 0 < s.lcm n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    (Finset.lcm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i hi => (hn i hi).ne'))
  rw [reciprocal_sum_as_card_sum s n a hn (s.lcm n) hL (fun _ hi => dvd_lcm hi)]
  unfold density coveredFinset
  apply (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right (by exact_mod_cast hL)).mpr
  exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_biUnion_le (s := s)
    (t := fun i => residueFinset (s.lcm n) (n i) (a i)))

name: Erdos278.density_eq_reciprocal_sum_iff
statement:
theorem density_eq_reciprocal_sum_iff {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < n i) (a : ι → ℤ) :
    density s n a = ∑ i ∈ s, (1 : ℚ) / n i ↔
      ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j → ¬ Compatible n a i j
proof:
:= by
  have hL : 0 < s.lcm n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    (Finset.lcm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i hi => (hn i hi).ne'))
  have hLQ : ((s.lcm n : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hL.ne'
  have cancel (u v : ℕ) :
      (u : ℚ) / (s.lcm n : ℕ) = (v : ℚ) / (s.lcm n : ℕ) ↔ u = v := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      field_simp [hLQ] at h
      exact_mod_cast h
    · rintro rfl
      rfl
  rw [reciprocal_sum_as_card_sum s n a hn (s.lcm n) hL (fun _ hi => dvd_lcm hi)]
  unfold density coveredFinset
  rw [cancel, union_card_eq_iff_pairwise_disjoint]
  constructor
  · intro h i hi j hj hij
    exact (residue_disjoint_iff _ _ _ hL (dvd_lcm hi) (dvd_lcm hj) _ _).mp (h i hi j hj hij)
  · intro h i hi j hj hij
    exact (residue_disjoint_iff _ _ _ hL (dvd_lcm hi) (dvd_lcm hj) _ _).mpr (h i hi j hj hij)

name: Erdos278.maximum_attains_union_bound_iff
statement:
theorem maximum_attains_union_bound_iff {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < n i) :
    (∃ a, (∀ b, density s n b ≤ density s n a) ∧
      density s n a = ∑ i ∈ s, (1 : ℚ) / n i) ↔
      ∃ a, ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j → ¬ Compatible n a i j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, _, ha⟩
    exact ⟨a, (density_eq_reciprocal_sum_iff s n hn a).mp ha⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    have heq := (density_eq_reciprocal_sum_iff s n hn a).mpr ha
    refine ⟨a, ?_, heq⟩
    intro b
    rw [heq]
    exact density_le_reciprocal_sum s n hn b

name: Erdos278.distinct_union_bound_reduction
statement:
theorem distinct_union_bound_reduction {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) :
    ∃ m : Fin r → ℕ, (∀ i, 0 < m i) ∧ Function.Injective m ∧
      ((∃ a, ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ¬ Compatible n a i j) ↔
        ∃ a, (∀ b, density univ m b ≤ density univ m a) ∧
          density univ m a = ∑ i, (1 : ℚ) / m i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hinj, heq⟩ := distinct_moduli_preserving_compatibility n hn
  refine ⟨m, hm, hinj, ?_⟩
  rw [maximum_attains_union_bound_iff univ m (fun i _ => hm i)]
  simp only [mem_univ, forall_const]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    exact ⟨a, fun i j hij hc => ha i j hij ((heq a i j).mp hc)⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    exact ⟨a, fun i j hij hc => ha i j hij ((heq a i j).mpr hc)⟩

name: Erdos278.residue_card_mul
statement:
theorem residue_card_mul (m k : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (a : ℤ) :
    (residueFinset (m * k) m a).card = k
proof:
:= by
  have hmQ : (m : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have heq : (((m * k : ℕ) : ℚ) - a) / (m : ℚ) =
      (k : ℚ) + (-(a : ℚ) / (m : ℚ)) := by
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  have hcard := Int.Ico_filter_modEq_card 0 (m * k : ℕ)
    (r := (m : ℤ)) (by exact_mod_cast hm) a
  simp only [Int.cast_natCast, Int.cast_zero, zero_sub, heq,
    Int.ceil_natCast_add, add_sub_cancel_right, max_eq_left (Int.natCast_nonneg k)] at hcard
  exact_mod_cast hcard

name: Erdos278.residue_ratio
statement:
theorem residue_ratio (m L : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hd : m ∣ L) (a : ℤ) :
    ((residueFinset L m a).card : ℚ) / L = 1 / m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hd
  rw [residue_card_mul m k hm]
  have hmQ : (m : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hkQ : (k : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    have : k ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hL
    exact_mod_cast this
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: Erdos278.intersection_ratio
statement:
theorem intersection_ratio (s t : Finset ι) (ht : t.Nonempty) (hts : t ⊆ s)
    (n : ι → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < n i) (a : ι → ℤ) :
    ((t.inf' ht (fun i => residueFinset (s.lcm n) (n i) (a i))).card : ℚ) /
      (s.lcm n : ℕ) = if IsClique n a t then (1 : ℚ) / (t.lcm n : ℕ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hL : 0 < s.lcm n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    (Finset.lcm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i hi => (hn i hi).ne'))
  have htpos : 0 < t.lcm n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    (Finset.lcm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i hi => (hn i (hts hi)).ne'))
  by_cases hc : IsClique n a t
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (generalized_crt t n a
      (fun i hi => (hn i (hts hi)).ne')).mpr hc
    have heq : t.inf' ht (fun i => residueFinset (s.lcm n) (n i) (a i)) =
        residueFinset (s.lcm n) (t.lcm n) z := by
      ext w
      simp only [Finset.mem_inf', residueFinset, mem_filter]
      constructor
      · intro h
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := ht
        exact ⟨(h i hi).1, (solution_iff_modEq_lcm t n a hz w).mp
          (fun j hj => (h j hj).2)⟩
      · rintro ⟨hw, hcong⟩ i hi
        exact ⟨hw, (solution_iff_modEq_lcm t n a hz w).mpr hcong i hi⟩
    rw [if_pos hc, heq]
    exact residue_ratio _ _ htpos hL (Finset.lcm_mono hts) z
  · have heq : t.inf' ht (fun i => residueFinset (s.lcm n) (n i) (a i)) = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro z hz
      apply hc
      apply (generalized_crt t n a (fun i hi => (hn i (hts hi)).ne')).mp
      refine ⟨z, fun i hi => ?_⟩
      exact (mem_filter.mp ((Finset.mem_inf' ht).mp hz i hi)).2
    simp [heq, hc]

name: Erdos278.density_eq_graphValue
statement:
theorem density_eq_graphValue (s : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < n i) (a : ι → ℤ) :
    density s n a = graphValue s n (Compatible n a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hIE := Finset.inclusion_exclusion_card_biUnion s
    (fun i => residueFinset (s.lcm n) (n i) (a i))
  have hIEQ : ((coveredFinset s n a).card : ℚ) =
      ∑ t : s.powerset.filter (·.Nonempty),
        (-1 : ℚ) ^ (t.1.card + 1) *
          (t.1.inf' (mem_filter.mp t.2).2
            (fun i => residueFinset (s.lcm n) (n i) (a i))).card := by
    exact_mod_cast hIE
  unfold density
  rw [hIEQ, Finset.sum_div]
  unfold graphValue
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro t _
  rw [mul_div_assoc, intersection_ratio s t.1 (mem_filter.mp t.2).2
    (mem_powerset.mp (mem_filter.mp t.2).1) n hn a]
  by_cases hc : IsClique n a t.1
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    have hc' : ∀ i ∈ t.1, ∀ j ∈ t.1, Compatible n a i j := hc
    rw [if_pos hc']
    ring
  · rw [if_neg hc]
    have hc' : ¬ (∀ i ∈ t.1, ∀ j ∈ t.1, Compatible n a i j) := hc
    rw [if_neg hc']
    simp

name: Erdos278.density_eq_of_compatible
statement:
theorem density_eq_of_compatible (s : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < n i) (a b : ι → ℤ)
    (h : ∀ i j, Compatible n a i j ↔ Compatible n b i j) :
    density s n a = density s n b
proof:
:= by
  rw [density_eq_graphValue s n hn a, density_eq_graphValue s n hn b]
  congr 1
  funext i j
  exact propext (h i j)

name: Erdos278.graph_optimization_exact
statement:
theorem graph_optimization_exact (s : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < n i) (d : ℚ) :
    (∃ a, density s n a = d) ↔
      ∃ G, Realizable n G ∧ graphValue s n G = d
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Compatible n a, ⟨a, fun _ _ => Iff.rfl⟩,
      (density_eq_graphValue s n hn a).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨G, ⟨a, ha⟩, hd⟩
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    rw [density_eq_graphValue s n hn a]
    have heq : G = Compatible n a := funext (fun i => funext (fun j => propext (ha i j)))
    rwa [heq] at hd

name: Erdos278.lcm_scale_nonempty
statement:
theorem lcm_scale_nonempty (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (g : ℕ) (b : ι → ℕ) :
    s.lcm (fun i => g * b i) = g * s.lcm b
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp at hs
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    by_cases hne : s.Nonempty
    · rw [Finset.lcm_insert, Finset.lcm_insert, ih hne]
      exact Nat.lcm_mul_left g (b i) (s.lcm b)
    · have he : s = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne
      subst s
      simp

name: Erdos278.common_gcd_compatible_iff
statement:
theorem common_gcd_compatible_iff (g : ℕ) (b : ι → ℕ)
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → (b i).Coprime (b j))
    (part : ι → Fin g) (i j : ι) :
    Compatible (fun k => g * b k) (fun k => (part k : ℤ)) i j ↔
      part i = part j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j; simp [Compatible]
  · unfold Compatible
    rw [Nat.gcd_mul_left, (hc i j hij).gcd_eq_one, mul_one,
      Int.natCast_modEq_iff]
    change (part i).val % g = (part j).val % g ↔ part i = part j
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (part i).isLt, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (part j).isLt]
    exact Fin.ext_iff.symm

name: Erdos278.sum_monochromatic_nonempty
statement:
theorem sum_monochromatic_nonempty {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) (part : ι → κ) :
    (∑ t : κ, if (∀ i ∈ s, part i = t) then (1 : ℚ) else 0) =
      if (∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, part i = part j) then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hs
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (part i)]
  · have he : (∀ j ∈ s, part j = part i) ↔
        (∀ j ∈ s, ∀ k ∈ s, part j = part k) := by
      exact ⟨fun h j hj k hk => (h j hj).trans (h k hk).symm,
        fun h j hj => h j hj i hi⟩
    simp only [he]
  · intro t _ ht
    have h : ¬ (∀ j ∈ s, part j = t) := fun h => ht (h i hi).symm
    simp [h]
  · simp

name: Erdos278.fiber_product_expansion
statement:
theorem fiber_product_expansion {κ : Type*} [DecidableEq κ]
    (s : Finset ι) (b : ι → ℕ) (part : ι → κ) (t : κ) :
    (∏ i ∈ s with part i = t, (1 - (1 : ℚ) / b i)) =
      ∑ u ∈ s.powerset,
        if (∀ i ∈ u, part i = t) then (-1 : ℚ) ^ u.card / (u.prod b : ℕ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp : (s.filter (fun i => part i = t)).powerset =
      s.powerset.filter (fun u => ∀ i ∈ u, part i = t) := by
    ext u
    simp only [mem_powerset, mem_filter]
    exact ⟨fun h => ⟨fun i hi => (mem_filter.mp (h hi)).1,
      fun i hi => (mem_filter.mp (h hi)).2⟩,
      fun h i hi => mem_filter.mpr ⟨h.1 hi, h.2 i hi⟩⟩
  rw [Finset.prod_sub, hp, Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro u _
  simp [div_eq_mul_inv]

name: Erdos278.common_gcd_uncovered_formula
statement:
theorem common_gcd_uncovered_formula (s : Finset ι) (g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g)
    (b : ι → ℕ) (hb : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < b i)
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → (b i).Coprime (b j)) (part : ι → Fin g) :
    1 - density s (fun i => g * b i) (fun i => (part i : ℤ)) =
      (∑ t : Fin g, ∏ i ∈ s with part i = t, (1 - (1 : ℚ) / b i)) / g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hgQ : (g : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [uncovered_eq_powerset s (fun i => g * b i)
    (fun i hi => Nat.mul_pos hg (hb i hi))]
  simp_rw [fiber_product_expansion]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_div]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro u hu
  by_cases he : u = ∅
  · subst u
    simp [uncoveredTerm, intersectionWeight, IsClique, hgQ]
  · have hne : u.Nonempty := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr he
    have hl : u.lcm (fun i => g * b i) = g * u.prod b := by
      rw [lcm_scale_nonempty u hne, Finset.lcm_eq_prod
        (fun i _ j _ hij => hc i j hij)]
    have hcolor : (∀ i ∈ u, ∀ j ∈ u, part i = part j) ↔
        IsClique (fun i => g * b i) (fun i => (part i : ℤ)) u := by
      simp only [IsClique, common_gcd_compatible_iff g b hc part]
    have hsum : (∑ t : Fin g, if (∀ i ∈ u, part i = t)
          then (-1 : ℚ) ^ u.card / (u.prod b : ℕ) else 0) =
        (∑ t : Fin g, if (∀ i ∈ u, part i = t) then (1 : ℚ) else 0) *
          ((-1 : ℚ) ^ u.card / (u.prod b : ℕ)) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro t _
      by_cases h : ∀ i ∈ u, part i = t <;> simp [h]
    rw [hsum, sum_monochromatic_nonempty u hne part]
    simp only [hcolor]
    unfold uncoveredTerm intersectionWeight
    by_cases hcl : IsClique (fun i => g * b i) (fun i => (part i : ℤ)) u
    · simp [hcl, hl, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
    · simp [hcl]

name: Erdos278.common_gcd_product_optimization
statement:
theorem common_gcd_product_optimization (g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g)
    (b : ι → ℕ) (hb : ∀ i, 0 < b i)
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → (b i).Coprime (b j)) (u : ℚ) :
    (∃ a : ι → ℤ, 1 - density univ (fun i => g * b i) a = u) ↔
      ∃ part : ι → Fin g, partitionCost g b part = u
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ∀ i, 0 < g * b i := fun i => Nat.mul_pos hg (hb i)
  have hgc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → (g * b i).gcd (g * b j) = g := by
    intro i j hij
    rw [Nat.gcd_mul_left, (hc i j hij).gcd_eq_one, mul_one]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    obtain ⟨part, hp⟩ := (common_gcd_partition_optimization
      (fun i => g * b i) hn g hg hgc (density univ (fun i => g * b i) a)).mp ⟨a, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨part, ?_⟩
    change (∑ t : Fin g, ∏ i ∈ univ with part i = t, (1 - (1 : ℚ) / b i)) / g = u
    rw [← common_gcd_uncovered_formula univ g hg b (fun i _ => hb i) hc part, hp]
    exact ha
  · rintro ⟨part, hp⟩
    exact ⟨fun i => (part i : ℤ),
      (common_gcd_uncovered_formula univ g hg b (fun i _ => hb i) hc part).trans hp⟩

name: Erdos278.common_gcd_optimum_product_formula
statement:
theorem common_gcd_optimum_product_formula (g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g)
    (b : ι → ℕ) (hb : ∀ i, 0 < b i)
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → (b i).Coprime (b j)) :
    ∃ (a : ι → ℤ) (part : ι → Fin g),
      (∀ x, density univ (fun i => g * b i) x ≤ density univ (fun i => g * b i) a) ∧
      1 - density univ (fun i => g * b i) a = partitionCost g b part ∧
      (∀ other, partitionCost g b part ≤ partitionCost g b other)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := maximum_attained (fun i => g * b i) (fun i => Nat.mul_pos hg (hb i))
  obtain ⟨part, hp⟩ := (common_gcd_product_optimization g hg b hb hc
    (1 - density univ (fun i => g * b i) a)).mp ⟨a, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨a, part, ha, hp.symm, fun other => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (common_gcd_product_optimization g hg b hb hc
    (partitionCost g b other)).mpr ⟨other, rfl⟩
  rw [hp, ← hx]
  linarith [ha x]

name: Erdos278.clique_iff_internal_pairs
statement:
theorem clique_iff_internal_pairs {r : ℕ} (s : Finset (Fin r))
    (n : Fin r → ℕ) (x : Fin r → ℤ) :
    IsClique n x s ↔ ∀ e : InternalPair s, Compatible n x e.1.1.1 e.1.1.2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h e
    exact h _ e.2.1 _ e.2.2
  · intro h i hi j hj
    rcases lt_trichotomy i j with hij | rfl | hji
    · exact h ⟨⟨(i, j), hij⟩, hi, hj⟩
    · exact Int.ModEq.refl _
    · have hc := (h ⟨⟨(j, i), hji⟩, hj, hi⟩).symm
      simpa only [Compatible, Nat.gcd_comm] using hc

name: Erdos278.model_pair_correct
statement:
theorem model_pair_correct {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (x : Fin r → ℤ) (q y : PairIndex r → ℤ)
    (hy : ∀ e, y e = 0 ∨ y e = 1)
    (hq : ∀ e, pairConstraint ((n e.1.1).gcd (n e.1.2))
      (x e.1.1 - x e.1.2) (q e) (y e)) (e : PairIndex r) :
    y e = 1 ↔ Compatible n x e.1.1 e.1.2
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (0 : ℤ) < (n e.1.1).gcd (n e.1.2) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left (n e.1.2) (hn e.1.1)
  exact ((pair_constraint_exact _ _ _ hd (hy e)).mp ⟨q e, hq e⟩).trans
    (compatible_iff_dvd n x e.1.1 e.1.2).symm

name: Erdos278.internal_edges_iff_clique
statement:
theorem internal_edges_iff_clique {r : ℕ} (s : Finset (Fin r))
    (n : Fin r → ℕ) (x : Fin r → ℤ) (y : PairIndex r → ℤ)
    (hy : ∀ e, y e = 1 ↔ Compatible n x e.1.1 e.1.2) :
    (∀ e : InternalPair s, (y e.1 : ℝ) = 1) ↔ IsClique n x s
proof:
:= by
  rw [clique_iff_internal_pairs]
  constructor
  · intro h e
    apply (hy e.1).mp
    exact_mod_cast h e
  · intro h e
    exact_mod_cast (hy e.1).mpr (h e)

name: Erdos278.model_objective_correct
statement:
theorem model_objective_correct {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (i₀ : Fin r) (x : Fin r → ℤ) (q y : PairIndex r → ℤ) (z : CliqueIndex r → ℝ)
    (hf : ModelFeasible n i₀ x q y z) :
    modelObjective n z = (density univ n x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨_, _, hy, hq, hz⟩ := hf
  have hpair := model_pair_correct n hn x q y hy hq
  have hzval (S : CliqueIndex r) : z S = if IsClique n x S.1 then 1 else 0 := by
    have hreal : ∀ e : InternalPair S.1, (y e.1 : ℝ) = 0 ∨ (y e.1 : ℝ) = 1 := by
      intro e
      rcases hy e.1 with h | h <;> simp [h]
    have h := (continuous_clique_indicator _ hreal (z S)).mp (hz S)
    simpa only [internal_edges_iff_clique S.1 n x y hpair] using h
  rw [density_eq_graphValue univ n (fun i _ => hn i) x]
  simp only [modelObjective, graphValue, Rat.cast_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro S _
  rw [hzval S]
  by_cases hc : IsClique n x S.1
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    have hc' : ∀ i ∈ S.1, ∀ j ∈ S.1, Compatible n x i j := hc
    rw [if_pos hc']
    simp
  · rw [if_neg hc]
    have hc' : ¬ (∀ i ∈ S.1, ∀ j ∈ S.1, Compatible n x i j) := hc
    rw [if_neg hc']
    simp

name: Erdos278.model_complete
statement:
theorem model_complete {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (i₀ : Fin r) (a : Fin r → ℤ) :
    ∃ x q y z, ModelFeasible n i₀ x q y z ∧ modelObjective n z = (density univ n a : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, hx0, hxb, hxa⟩ := normalized_compressed_witness n hn a i₀
  let y : PairIndex r → ℤ := fun e => if Compatible n x e.1.1 e.1.2 then 1 else 0
  have hy (e : PairIndex r) : y e = 0 ∨ y e = 1 := by
    dsimp [y]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have hpair (e : PairIndex r) : y e = 1 ↔ Compatible n x e.1.1 e.1.2 := by simp [y]
  have hqex (e : PairIndex r) : ∃ q : ℤ,
      pairConstraint ((n e.1.1).gcd (n e.1.2)) (x e.1.1 - x e.1.2) q (y e) := by
    apply (pair_constraint_exact _ _ _ (by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left (n e.1.2) (hn e.1.1)) (hy e)).mpr
    exact (hpair e).trans (compatible_iff_dvd n x e.1.1 e.1.2)
  let q : PairIndex r → ℤ := fun e => Classical.choose (hqex e)
  let z : CliqueIndex r → ℝ := fun S => if IsClique n x S.1 then 1 else 0
  have hz (S : CliqueIndex r) : andConstraints
      (fun e : InternalPair S.1 => (y e.1 : ℝ)) (z S) := by
    have hreal : ∀ e : InternalPair S.1, (y e.1 : ℝ) = 0 ∨ (y e.1 : ℝ) = 1 := by
      intro e
      rcases hy e.1 with h | h <;> simp [h]
    apply (continuous_clique_indicator _ hreal (z S)).mpr
    simp only [internal_edges_iff_clique S.1 n x y hpair, z]
  have hf : ModelFeasible n i₀ x q y z :=
    ⟨hx0, hxb, hy, fun e => Classical.choose_spec (hqex e), hz⟩
  refine ⟨x, q, y, z, hf, ?_⟩
  rw [model_objective_correct n hn i₀ x q y z hf]
  exact_mod_cast density_eq_of_compatible univ n (fun i _ => hn i) x a hxa

name: Erdos278.mixed_integer_optimization_exact
statement:
theorem mixed_integer_optimization_exact {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) (i₀ : Fin r) (d : ℚ) :
    (∃ a, density univ n a = d) ↔
      ∃ x q y z, ModelFeasible n i₀ x q y z ∧ modelObjective n z = (d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact model_complete n hn i₀ a
  · rintro ⟨x, q, y, z, hf, hd⟩
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    rw [model_objective_correct n hn i₀ x q y z hf] at hd
    exact_mod_cast hd

name: Erdos278.radix_dp_digits
statement:
theorem radix_dp_digits {r : ℕ} {β : Type*} [Fintype β]
    (hr : 0 < r) (b : β → ℕ) (e : Fin r → β → ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ j, 0 < b j) (H : SeparationMask r) :
    H ∈ radixDP b e ↔ ∃ u : ∀ j, ℕ → Fin r → Fin (b j),
      H = radixSeparation b e u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [radixDP, coordinate_dp_exact hr (radixSupport e)
    (fun c : RadixCoordinate e => b c.1) (fun c => hb c.1)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
    let u : ∀ j, ℕ → Fin r → Fin (b j) := fun j t i =>
      if ht : t < univ.sup (fun i => e i j) then v ⟨j, ⟨t, ht⟩⟩ i else ⟨0, hb j⟩
    refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
    apply biUnion_congr rfl
    intro c _
    congr 1
    funext i
    simp only [u, dif_pos c.2.isLt]
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨fun c => u c.1 c.2.val, rfl⟩

name: Erdos278.radix_separation_eq_mask
statement:
theorem radix_separation_eq_mask {r : ℕ} {β : Type*} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    (b : β → ℕ) (e : Fin r → β → ℕ) (hb : ∀ j, 0 < b j)
    (hc : Pairwise (fun j k => (b j).Coprime (b k)))
    (u : ∀ j, ℕ → Fin r → Fin (b j)) (a : Fin r → ℤ)
    (ha : ∀ i j, a i ≡ (radixPrefix (b j) (fun t => u j t i) (e i j) : ℤ)
      [ZMOD (b j)^(e i j)]) :
    radixSeparation b e u = incompatibilityMask (fun i => radixModulus b (e i)) a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext p
  simp only [radixSeparation, mem_biUnion, mem_univ, true_and,
    separationMask, radixSupport, mem_filter, incompatibilityMask]
  rw [radix_compatible_iff b e hb hc u a ha]
  push Not
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hi, hh, hne⟩
    exact ⟨c.1, c.2.val, hi, hh, hne⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, t, hi, hh, hne⟩
    have ht : t < univ.sup (fun i => e i j) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hi (Finset.le_sup (f := fun i => e i j) (mem_univ p.1.1))
    exact ⟨⟨j, ⟨t, ht⟩⟩, hi, hh, hne⟩

name: Erdos278.radix_dp_realizable_exact
statement:
theorem radix_dp_realizable_exact {r : ℕ} {β : Type*} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    (hr : 0 < r) (b : β → ℕ) (e : Fin r → β → ℕ) (hb : ∀ j, 0 < b j)
    (hc : Pairwise (fun j k => (b j).Coprime (b k))) (H : SeparationMask r) :
    H ∈ radixDP b e ↔
      ∃ a : Fin r → ℤ, H = incompatibilityMask (fun i => radixModulus b (e i)) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [radix_dp_digits hr b e hb]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := radix_digits_reconstruct b e hb hc u
    exact ⟨a, radix_separation_eq_mask b e hb hc u a ha⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨u, ha⟩ := radix_residues_encode b e hb a
    exact ⟨u, (radix_separation_eq_mask b e hb hc u a ha).symm⟩

name: Erdos278.canonical_representatives
statement:
theorem canonical_representatives (n : ι → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) (a : ι → ℤ) :
    ∃ b : (i : ι) → Fin (n i), ∀ i, (b i : ℤ) = a i % n i
proof:
:= by
  let b : (i : ι) → Fin (n i) := fun i => ⟨(a i % n i).toNat, by
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ a i % (n i : ℤ) :=
      Int.emod_nonneg (a i) (by exact_mod_cast (hn i).ne')
    have hcast : ((a i % n i).toNat : ℤ) = a i % n i := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnonneg
    have hlt : ((a i % n i).toNat : ℤ) < n i := by
      rw [hcast]
      exact Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ (by exact_mod_cast hn i)
    exact_mod_cast hlt⟩
  refine ⟨b, fun i => ?_⟩
  exact Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Int.emod_nonneg _ (by exact_mod_cast (hn i).ne'))

name: Erdos278.maximum_attained
statement:
theorem maximum_attained (n : ι → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) :
    ∃ a : ι → ℤ, ∀ b : ι → ℤ, density univ n b ≤ density univ n a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : ((i : ι) → Fin (n i)) → ℚ := fun b => density univ n (fun i => (b i : ℤ))
  have hnonempty : (univ : Finset ((i : ι) → Fin (n i))).Nonempty :=
    ⟨fun i => ⟨0, hn i⟩, mem_univ _⟩
  obtain ⟨a, _, ha⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image univ f hnonempty
  refine ⟨fun i => (a i : ℤ), fun b => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := canonical_representatives n hn b
  have heq : density univ n (fun i => (c i : ℤ)) = density univ n b := by
    apply density_eq_of_compatible univ n (fun i _ => hn i)
    intro i j
    simp_rw [hc]
    exact reduce_preserves_compatibility n b i j
  rw [← heq]
  exact ha c (mem_univ _)

name: Erdos278.normalized_compressed_witness
statement:
theorem normalized_compressed_witness (n : ι → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (a : ι → ℤ) (i₀ : ι) :
    ∃ x : ι → ℤ, x i₀ = 0 ∧
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i < interactionModulus n i) ∧
      (∀ i j, Compatible n x i j ↔ Compatible n a i j)
proof:
:= by
  let x : ι → ℤ := fun i => (a i - a i₀) % interactionModulus n i
  refine ⟨x, by simp [x], ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    have hp : (0 : ℤ) < interactionModulus n i := by exact_mod_cast interaction_pos n hn i
    exact ⟨Int.emod_nonneg _ hp.ne', Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ hp⟩
  · intro i j
    exact (interaction_compression n x (fun i => a i - a i₀)
      (fun i => Int.mod_modEq _ _) i j).trans
        (translate_preserves_compatibility n a (a i₀) i j)

name: Erdos278.input_radix_prime
statement:
theorem input_radix_prime {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (p : inputPrimes n) :
    (inputPrimeRadix n p).Prime
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := mem_biUnion.mp p.2
  exact Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hi

name: Erdos278.input_radices_coprime
statement:
theorem input_radices_coprime {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) :
    Pairwise (fun p q => (inputPrimeRadix n p).Coprime (inputPrimeRadix n q))
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  apply (Nat.coprime_primes (input_radix_prime n p) (input_radix_prime n q)).mpr
  exact fun h => hpq (Subtype.ext h)

name: Erdos278.input_radix_representation
statement:
theorem input_radix_representation {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) (i : Fin r) :
    radixModulus (inputPrimeRadix n) (inputPrimeExponents n i) = n i
proof:
:= by
  rw [radix_modulus_eq_product _ _ (input_radices_coprime n)]
  change (∏ p : inputPrimes n, p.val ^ (n i).factorization p.val) = n i
  rw [Finset.univ_eq_attach, Finset.prod_attach (inputPrimes n)
    (fun p => p ^ (n i).factorization p)]
  have hsub : (n i).primeFactors ⊆ inputPrimes n :=
    fun p hp => mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, mem_univ i, hp⟩
  have heq := Finset.prod_subset (f := fun p => p ^ (n i).factorization p) hsub
    (fun p _ hp => by
      have hz : (n i).factorization p = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hp
      simp [hz])
  rw [← heq]
  exact (Nat.prod_primeFactors_pow_factorization (hn i).ne').symm

name: Erdos278.prime_dp_density_exact
statement:
theorem prime_dp_density_exact {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (n : Fin r → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) (d : ℚ) :
    (∃ H ∈ primeDP n, maskDensity n H = d) ↔
      ∃ a : Fin r → ℤ, density univ n a = d
proof:
:=
  radix_dp_density_exact hr n _ _ (fun p => (input_radix_prime n p).pos)
    (input_radices_coprime n) (input_radix_representation n hn) d

name: Erdos278.prime_dp_maximum
statement:
theorem prime_dp_maximum {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (n : Fin r → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) :
    ∃ H ∈ primeDP n, ∃ a : Fin r → ℤ,
      maskDensity n H = density univ n a ∧
      (∀ K ∈ primeDP n, maskDensity n K ≤ maskDensity n H) ∧
      (∀ x : Fin r → ℤ, density univ n x ≤ density univ n a)
proof:
:=
  radix_dp_maximum hr n _ _ (fun p => (input_radix_prime n p).pos)
    (input_radices_coprime n) (input_radix_representation n hn)

name: Erdos278.prime_dp_coordinate_bound
proof:
:= by
  have h := radix_coordinate_count_le_bit_bound (inputPrimeRadix n) (inputPrimeExponents n)
    (fun p => (input_radix_prime n p).two_le) (input_radices_coprime n)
  simpa only [input_radix_representation n hn] using h

name: Erdos278.radix_coordinate_card
statement:
theorem radix_coordinate_card {r : ℕ} {β : Type*} [Fintype β]
    (e : Fin r → β → ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (RadixCoordinate e) = radixCoordinateCount e
proof:
:= by
  simp [RadixCoordinate, radixCoordinateCount]

name: Erdos278.prime_dp_state_bound
statement:
theorem prime_dp_state_bound {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) :
    (primeDP n).card ≤ 2 ^ (r * (r-1) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [separation_mask_universe_card] using (primeDP n).card_le_univ

name: Erdos278.verified_dp_maximum_density
statement:
theorem verified_dp_maximum_density {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (n : Fin r → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) :
    ∃ H ∈ primeDP n, ∃ a : Fin r → ℤ, ∃ d : ℚ,
      d = maskDensity n H ∧ d = density univ n a ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (Nat.count (CoveredNat univ n a) N : ℝ) / N)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (d : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ K ∈ primeDP n, maskDensity n K ≤ d) ∧
      (∀ x : Fin r → ℤ, density univ n x ≤ d)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨H, hH, a, ha, hmax, hglobal⟩ := prime_dp_maximum hr n hn
  refine ⟨H, hH, a, density univ n a, ha.symm, rfl,
    density_is_natural_density univ n (fun i _ => hn i) a, ?_, hglobal⟩
  simpa only [ha] using hmax

name: Erdos278.pair_constraint_exact
statement:
theorem pair_constraint_exact (d t y : ℤ) (hd : 0 < d) (hy : y = 0 ∨ y = 1) :
    (∃ q : ℤ, pairConstraint d t q y) ↔ (y = 1 ↔ d ∣ t)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hy with rfl | rfl
  · simp only [zero_ne_one, false_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨q, hlo, hhi⟩ ht
      have hdiv : d ∣ t - d * q := dvd_sub ht (dvd_mul_right d q)
      have hpos : 0 < t - d * q := by omega
      have := Int.le_of_dvd hpos hdiv
      simp only [sub_zero, mul_one] at hhi
      omega
    · intro ht
      refine ⟨t / d, ?_⟩
      have hnonneg := Int.emod_nonneg t hd.ne'
      have hlt := Int.emod_lt_of_pos t hd
      have hne : t % d ≠ 0 := mt Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero ht
      have hrem := Int.emod_add_mul_ediv t d
      unfold pairConstraint
      simp only [sub_zero, mul_one]
      omega
  · simp only [true_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨q, hlo, hhi⟩
      refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
      simp only [sub_self, mul_zero] at hlo hhi
      omega
    · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨q, by simp [pairConstraint]⟩

name: Erdos278.nonedge_remainder_exact
statement:
theorem nonedge_remainder_exact (d t : ℤ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    (∃ q s : ℤ, t = d * q + s ∧ 1 ≤ s ∧ s ≤ d - 1) ↔ ¬d ∣ t
proof:
:= by
  have h := pair_constraint_exact d t 0 hd (Or.inl rfl)
  simp only [zero_ne_one, false_iff] at h
  rw [← h]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, s, ht, hs, hs'⟩
    exact ⟨q, by simp only [pairConstraint, sub_zero, mul_one]; omega⟩
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
    exact ⟨q, t - d * q, by ring, by simpa [pairConstraint] using hq⟩

name: Erdos278.continuous_clique_indicator
statement:
theorem continuous_clique_indicator {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (y : α → ℝ) (hy : ∀ e, y e = 0 ∨ y e = 1) (z : ℝ) :
    andConstraints y z ↔ z = if (∀ e, y e = 1) then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hall : ∀ e, y e = 1
  · have hsum : ∑ e, (1 - y e) = 0 := by simp [hall]
    simp only [if_pos hall]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, hz, _, hl⟩
      rw [hsum] at hl
      linarith
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨by norm_num, le_rfl, fun e => by rw [hall], by simp [hsum]⟩
  · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := not_forall.mp hall
    have he0 : y e = 0 := (hy e).resolve_right he
    have hsum : 1 ≤ ∑ e, (1 - y e) := by
      calc
        1 = 1 - y e := by rw [he0]; norm_num
        _ ≤ ∑ e, (1 - y e) := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => 1 - y i)
          (fun i _ => by rcases hy i with h | h <;> simp [h]) (mem_univ e)
    simp only [if_neg hall]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hz, _, hu, _⟩
      have := hu e
      rw [he0] at this
      linarith
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨le_rfl, by norm_num,
        fun e => by rcases hy e with h | h <;> simp [h], by linarith⟩
