name: Erdos278.radix_coordinate_count_le_sum
statement:
theorem radix_coordinate_count_le_sum {r : ℕ} {β : Type*} [Fintype β]
    (e : Fin r → β → ℕ) : radixCoordinateCount e ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, e i j
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ j, ∑ i, e i j := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      exact Finset.sup_le_iff.mpr (fun i hi =>
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => e i j) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) hi)
    _ = _ := Finset.sum_comm

name: Erdos278.radix_exponent_sum_le_log
statement:
theorem radix_exponent_sum_le_log {β : Type*} [Fintype β]
    (b e : β → ℕ) (hb : ∀ j, 2 ≤ b j)
    (hc : Pairwise (fun j k => (b j).Coprime (b k))) :
    (∑ j, e j) ≤ Nat.log 2 (radixModulus b e)
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.le_log_of_pow_le (by decide)
  rw [radix_modulus_eq_product b e hc, ← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
  exact Finset.prod_le_prod' (fun j _ => Nat.pow_le_pow_left (hb j) _)

name: Erdos278.radix_coordinate_count_le_bit_bound
statement:
theorem radix_coordinate_count_le_bit_bound {r : ℕ} {β : Type*} [Fintype β]
    (b : β → ℕ) (e : Fin r → β → ℕ) (hb : ∀ j, 2 ≤ b j)
    (hc : Pairwise (fun j k => (b j).Coprime (b k))) :
    radixCoordinateCount e ≤ ∑ i, Nat.clog 2 (radixModulus b (e i))
proof:
:= by
  apply (radix_coordinate_count_le_sum e).trans
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ =>
    (radix_exponent_sum_le_log b (e i) hb hc).trans (Nat.log_le_clog _ _))

name: Erdos278.separation_total_candidate_bound
statement:
theorem separation_total_candidate_bound {r : ℕ} (d : ℕ)
    (V : ℕ → Finset (Fin r)) (b : ℕ → ℕ) :
    (∑ t ∈ range d,
      (separationDP (fun k => localSeparationMasks (V k) (b k)) t ×ˢ
        localSeparationMasks (V t) (b t)).card) ≤
      d * (2 ^ (r * (r-1) / 2) * r ^ r)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _t ∈ range d, 2 ^ (r * (r-1) / 2) * r ^ r :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun t _ => separation_step_candidate_bound _ _ _)
    _ = _ := by simp

name: Erdos278.separation_transition_exponential_bound
statement:
theorem separation_transition_exponential_bound (r : ℕ) :
    2 ^ (r * (r-1) / 2) * r ^ r ≤ 2 ^ (2 * r * r)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : r ^ r ≤ 2 ^ (r * r) := by
    rw [pow_mul]
    exact Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := r))) r
  have hq : r * (r-1) / 2 ≤ r * r :=
    (Nat.div_le_self _ _).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left r (Nat.sub_le _ _))
  calc
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (r * (r-1) / 2) * 2 ^ (r * r) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hr
    _ = 2 ^ (r * (r-1) / 2 + r * r) := (pow_add _ _ _).symm
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (2 * r * r) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by nlinarith)

name: Erdos278.separation_total_exponential_bound
statement:
theorem separation_total_exponential_bound {r : ℕ} (d : ℕ)
    (V : ℕ → Finset (Fin r)) (b : ℕ → ℕ) :
    (∑ t ∈ range d,
      (separationDP (fun k => localSeparationMasks (V k) (b k)) t ×ˢ
        localSeparationMasks (V t) (b t)).card) ≤ d * 2 ^ (2 * r * r)
proof:
:=
  (separation_total_candidate_bound d V b).trans
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_left d (separation_transition_exponential_bound r))

name: Erdos278.private_factors_gcd
statement:
theorem private_factors_gcd (a b u v : ℕ)
    (hub : u.Coprime b) (hva : v.Coprime a) (huv : u.Coprime v) :
    (a * u).gcd (b * v) = a.gcd b
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.Coprime.gcd_mul_right_cancel a (hub.mul_right huv),
    Nat.Coprime.gcd_mul_right_cancel_right b hva]

name: Erdos278.private_factors_compatibility
statement:
theorem private_factors_compatibility {ι : Type*} (n t : ι → ℕ)
    (hbase : ∀ i j, (t i).Coprime (n j))
    (htags : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → (t i).Coprime (t j))
    (a : ι → ℤ) (i j : ι) :
    Compatible (fun k => n k * t k) a i j ↔ Compatible n a i j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    exact ⟨fun _ => Int.ModEq.refl _, fun _ => Int.ModEq.refl _⟩
  · unfold Compatible
    rw [private_factors_gcd (n i) (n j) (t i) (t j)
      (hbase i j) (hbase j i) (htags i j hij)]

name: Erdos278.private_factors_injective
statement:
theorem private_factors_injective {ι : Type*} (n t : ι → ℕ)
    (hbase : ∀ i j, (t i).Coprime (n j))
    (htags : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → (t i).Coprime (t j)) (ht : ∀ i, 1 < t i) :
    Function.Injective (fun i => n i * t i)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j heq
  change n i * t i = n j * t j at heq
  by_contra hij
  have hc : (t i).Coprime (n j * t j) := (hbase i j).mul_right (htags i j hij)
  have hd : t i ∣ n j * t j := by
    rw [← heq]
    exact dvd_mul_left _ _
  have := hc.eq_one_of_dvd hd
  have := ht i
  omega

name: Erdos278.affine_tags_coprime
statement:
theorem affine_tags_coprime (K i j : ℕ) (hdiff : j - i ∣ K) :
    (1 + i * K).Coprime (1 + j * K)
proof:
:= by
  let a := 1 + i * K
  let b := 1 + j * K
  let d := a.gcd b
  have haK : a.Coprime K := by simp [a]
  have hda : d ∣ a := Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b
  have hdb : d ∣ b := Nat.gcd_dvd_right a b
  have hdK : d.Coprime K := Nat.Coprime.of_dvd_left hda haK
  have hdiff' : d ∣ (j - i) * K := by
    have h := Nat.dvd_sub hdb hda
    change d ∣ 1 + j * K - (1 + i * K) at h
    have heq : 1 + j * K - (1 + i * K) = j * K - i * K := by omega
    simpa only [heq, Nat.sub_mul] using h
  have hsmall : d ∣ j - i := hdK.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hdiff'
  exact Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_coprimes haK hda (hsmall.trans hdiff)

name: Erdos278.separation_tags_coprime
statement:
theorem separation_tags_coprime {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (i j : Fin r) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (separationTag n i).Coprime (separationTag n j)
proof:
:= by
  have hlt (i j : Fin r) (hij : i < j) :
      (separationTag n i).Coprime (separationTag n j) := by
    apply affine_tags_coprime
    have hd : j.val + 1 - (i.val + 1) ∣ r.factorial :=
      Nat.dvd_factorial (by omega) (by omega)
    exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left hd _
  rcases lt_trichotomy i j with h | h | h
  · exact hlt i j h
  · exact (hij h).elim
  · exact (hlt j i h).symm

name: Erdos278.separation_tags_avoid_moduli
statement:
theorem separation_tags_avoid_moduli {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (i j : Fin r) :
    (separationTag n i).Coprime (n j)
proof:
:= by
  have hprod : n j ∣ ∏ k, n k := Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem n (mem_univ j)
  have hd : n j ∣ taggingScale n := dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hprod _
  apply Nat.Coprime.of_dvd_right hd
  simp [separationTag]

name: Erdos278.separation_tags_gt_one
statement:
theorem separation_tags_gt_one {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) (i : Fin r) :
    1 < separationTag n i
proof:
:= by
  have hK : 0 < taggingScale n :=
    Nat.mul_pos (Nat.factorial_pos r)
      (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun j _ => (hn j).ne')))
  have hp : 0 < (i.val + 1) * taggingScale n := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hK
  unfold separationTag
  omega

name: Erdos278.distinct_moduli_preserving_compatibility
statement:
theorem distinct_moduli_preserving_compatibility {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) :
    ∃ m : Fin r → ℕ, (∀ i, 0 < m i) ∧ Function.Injective m ∧
      ∀ a : Fin r → ℤ, ∀ i j, Compatible m a i j ↔ Compatible n a i j
proof:
:= by
  let t := separationTag n
  refine ⟨fun i => n i * t i, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    exact Nat.mul_pos (hn i) (Nat.lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one (separation_tags_gt_one n hn i))
  · exact private_factors_injective n t (separation_tags_avoid_moduli n)
      (separation_tags_coprime n) (separation_tags_gt_one n hn)
  · exact private_factors_compatibility n t (separation_tags_avoid_moduli n)
      (separation_tags_coprime n)

name: Erdos278.interaction_vertices_card
statement:
theorem interaction_vertices_card {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) :
    (interactionVertices n).card ≤ 2 * (interactionPairs n).card
proof:
:=
  interacting_vertices_bound _

name: Erdos278.isolated_vertex_coprime
statement:
theorem isolated_vertex_coprime {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) {i j : Fin r}
    (hi : i ∉ interactionVertices n) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (n i).Coprime (n j)
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.mpr
  by_contra h
  have hpos := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left (n j) (hn i)
  have hg : 1 < (n i).gcd (n j) := by omega
  apply hi
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hlt | hgt
  · exact mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨⟨(i,j), hlt⟩,
      by simpa [interactionPairs] using hg, by simp⟩
  · exact mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨⟨(j,i), hgt⟩,
      by simpa [interactionPairs, Nat.gcd_comm] using hg, by simp⟩

name: Erdos278.isolated_vertices_factorization
statement:
theorem isolated_vertices_factorization {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) (a : Fin r → ℤ) :
    1 - density univ n a = (1 - density (interactionVertices n) n a) *
      ∏ i ∈ univ \ interactionVertices n, (1 - (1 : ℚ) / n i)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : interactionVertices n ∪ (univ \ interactionVertices n) = univ := by
    ext i; simp
  have hc : ∀ i ∈ interactionVertices n, ∀ j ∈ univ \ interactionVertices n,
      (n i).Coprime (n j) := by
    intro i hi j hj
    have hjn := (mem_sdiff.mp hj).2
    exact (isolated_vertex_coprime n hn hjn (fun he => hjn (he ▸ hi))).symm
  have hf := uncovered_component_factorization
    (interactionVertices n) (univ \ interactionVertices n)
    (disjoint_left.mpr (fun i hi hj => (mem_sdiff.mp hj).2 hi))
    n (fun i _ => hn i) a hc
  rw [hu, coprime_uncovered_product _ n (fun i _ => hn i) a
    (fun i hi j _ hij => isolated_vertex_coprime n hn (mem_sdiff.mp hi).2 hij)] at hf
  exact hf

name: Erdos278.isolated_optimum_lift
statement:
theorem isolated_optimum_lift {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) (a : Fin r → ℤ)
    (ha : ∀ x, density (interactionVertices n) n x ≤
      density (interactionVertices n) n a) :
    ∀ x, density univ n x ≤ density univ n a
proof:
:= by
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∏ i ∈ univ \ interactionVertices n, (1 - (1 : ℚ) / n i) := by
    rw [← coprime_uncovered_product _ n (fun i _ => hn i) a
      (fun i hi j _ hij => isolated_vertex_coprime n hn (mem_sdiff.mp hi).2 hij)]
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr (density_bounds _ n (fun i _ => hn i) a).2
  intro x
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (sub_le_sub_left (ha x) 1) hnonneg
  have hfa := isolated_vertices_factorization n hn a
  have hfx := isolated_vertices_factorization n hn x
  linarith

name: Erdos278.supported_masks_card_bound
proof:

  calc
    _ ≤ E.powerset.card := card_le_card (fun H hH => mem_powerset.mpr (hE H hH))

name: Erdos278.local_masks_supported
statement:
theorem local_masks_supported {r : ℕ} (V : Finset (Fin r)) (b : ℕ)
    (E : SeparationMask r)
    (hV : ∀ p : PairIndex r, p.1.1 ∈ V → p.1.2 ∈ V → p ∈ E)
    (H : SeparationMask r) (hH : H ∈ localSeparationMasks V b) : H ⊆ E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, _, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hH
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨_, hi, hj, _⟩ := mem_filter.mp hp
  exact hV p hi hj

name: Erdos278.local_masks_sparse_card_bound
statement:
theorem local_masks_sparse_card_bound {r : ℕ} (V : Finset (Fin r)) (b : ℕ)
    (E : SeparationMask r)
    (hV : ∀ p : PairIndex r, p.1.1 ∈ V → p.1.2 ∈ V → p ∈ E) :
    (localSeparationMasks V b).card ≤ 2 ^ E.card
proof:
:=
  supported_masks_card_bound _ E (local_masks_supported V b E hV)

name: Erdos278.separation_dp_supported
statement:
theorem separation_dp_supported {r : ℕ}
    (choices : ℕ → Finset (SeparationMask r)) (k : ℕ) (E : SeparationMask r)
    (hE : ∀ t < k, ∀ H ∈ choices t, H ⊆ E)
    (H : SeparationMask r) (hH : H ∈ separationDP choices k) : H ⊆ E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := (separation_dp_exact choices k H).mp hH
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hp⟩ := mem_biUnion.mp hp
  exact hE t (mem_range.mp ht) (f t) (hf t (mem_range.mp ht)) hp

name: Erdos278.separation_dp_sparse_state_bound
statement:
theorem separation_dp_sparse_state_bound {r : ℕ}
    (choices : ℕ → Finset (SeparationMask r)) (k : ℕ) (E : SeparationMask r)
    (hE : ∀ t < k, ∀ H ∈ choices t, H ⊆ E) :
    (separationDP choices k).card ≤ 2 ^ E.card
proof:
:=
  supported_masks_card_bound _ E (separation_dp_supported choices k E hE)

name: Erdos278.separation_total_sparse_candidate_bound
statement:
theorem separation_total_sparse_candidate_bound {r : ℕ}
    (choices : ℕ → Finset (SeparationMask r)) (d : ℕ) (E : SeparationMask r)
    (hE : ∀ t < d, ∀ H ∈ choices t, H ⊆ E) :
    (∑ t ∈ range d, (separationDP choices t ×ˢ choices t).card) ≤
      d * 2 ^ (2 * E.card)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _t ∈ range d, 2 ^ (2 * E.card) := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro t ht
      rw [card_product, two_mul, pow_add]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul
        (separation_dp_sparse_state_bound choices t E
          (fun s hs => hE s (hs.trans (mem_range.mp ht))))
        (supported_masks_card_bound _ E (hE t (mem_range.mp ht)))
    _ = _ := by simp

name: Erdos278.finite_schedule_supported
statement:
theorem finite_schedule_supported {r : ℕ} {C : Type*} [Fintype C]
    (choices : C → Finset (SeparationMask r)) (E : SeparationMask r)
    (hE : ∀ c, ∀ H ∈ choices c, H ⊆ E) (t : ℕ)
    (H : SeparationMask r) (hH : H ∈ finiteSeparationSchedule choices t) : H ⊆ E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases ht : t < Fintype.card C
  · exact hE _ H (by simpa [finiteSeparationSchedule, ht] using hH)
  · have hh : H = ∅ := by simpa [finiteSeparationSchedule, ht] using hH
    simp [hh]

name: Erdos278.finite_separation_dp_sparse_state_bound
statement:
theorem finite_separation_dp_sparse_state_bound {r : ℕ} {C : Type*} [Fintype C]
    (choices : C → Finset (SeparationMask r)) (E : SeparationMask r)
    (hE : ∀ c, ∀ H ∈ choices c, H ⊆ E) :
    (finiteSeparationDP choices).card ≤ 2 ^ E.card
proof:
:=
  separation_dp_sparse_state_bound (finiteSeparationSchedule choices) _ E
    (fun t _ => finite_schedule_supported choices E hE t)

name: Erdos278.finite_separation_sparse_candidate_bound
statement:
theorem finite_separation_sparse_candidate_bound {r : ℕ} {C : Type*} [Fintype C]
    (choices : C → Finset (SeparationMask r)) (E : SeparationMask r)
    (hE : ∀ c, ∀ H ∈ choices c, H ⊆ E) :
    finiteSeparationCandidateCount choices ≤ Fintype.card C * 2 ^ (2 * E.card)
proof:
:=
  separation_total_sparse_candidate_bound (finiteSeparationSchedule choices) _ E
    (fun t _ => finite_schedule_supported choices E hE t)

name: Erdos278.radix_support_interaction
statement:
theorem radix_support_interaction {r : ℕ} {β : Type*} [Fintype β]
    (n : Fin r → ℕ) (b : β → ℕ) (e : Fin r → β → ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ j, 2 ≤ b j) (hrep : ∀ i, radixModulus b (e i) = n i)
    (c : RadixCoordinate e) (p : PairIndex r)
    (hi : p.1.1 ∈ radixSupport e c) (hj : p.1.2 ∈ radixSupport e c) :
    p ∈ interactionPairs n
proof:
:= by
  have hdiv (i : Fin r) (h : c.2.val < e i c.1) : b c.1 ∣ n i := by
    rw [← hrep i]
    exact (dvd_pow_self (b c.1) (by omega : e i c.1 ≠ 0)).trans
      (Finset.dvd_lcm (mem_univ c.1))
  have hni : 0 < n p.1.1 := by
    rw [← hrep p.1.1]
    exact radix_modulus_pos b _ (fun j => lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide) (hb j))
  have hd := Nat.dvd_gcd
    (hdiv p.1.1 (mem_filter.mp hi).2) (hdiv p.1.2 (mem_filter.mp hj).2)
  have hbase := hb c.1
  exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega : 1 < b c.1)
    (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ hni) hd)⟩

name: Erdos278.radix_dp_sparse_state_bound
statement:
theorem radix_dp_sparse_state_bound {r : ℕ} {β : Type*} [Fintype β]
    (n : Fin r → ℕ) (b : β → ℕ) (e : Fin r → β → ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ j, 2 ≤ b j) (hrep : ∀ i, radixModulus b (e i) = n i) :
    (radixDP b e).card ≤ 2 ^ (interactionPairs n).card
proof:
:=
  finite_separation_dp_sparse_state_bound _ _ (fun c =>
    local_masks_supported _ _ _ (radix_support_interaction n b e hb hrep c))

name: Erdos278.radix_dp_sparse_candidate_bound
statement:
theorem radix_dp_sparse_candidate_bound {r : ℕ} {β : Type*} [Fintype β]
    (n : Fin r → ℕ) (b : β → ℕ) (e : Fin r → β → ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ j, 2 ≤ b j) (hrep : ∀ i, radixModulus b (e i) = n i) :
    finiteSeparationCandidateCount (fun c : RadixCoordinate e =>
      localSeparationMasks (radixSupport e c) (b c.1)) ≤
      radixCoordinateCount e * 2 ^ (2 * (interactionPairs n).card)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [radix_coordinate_card] using
    finite_separation_sparse_candidate_bound
      (fun c : RadixCoordinate e => localSeparationMasks (radixSupport e c) (b c.1))
      (interactionPairs n) (fun c =>
        local_masks_supported _ _ _ (radix_support_interaction n b e hb hrep c))

name: Erdos278.sparse_objective_candidate_bound
statement:
theorem sparse_objective_candidate_bound {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ)
    (R : Finset (SeparationMask r)) (hR : R.card ≤ 2 ^ (interactionPairs n).card) :
    (R ×ˢ (interactionVertices n).powerset).card ≤ 2 ^ (3 * (interactionPairs n).card)
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_product, card_powerset]
  calc
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (interactionPairs n).card * 2 ^ (2 * (interactionPairs n).card) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul hR
        (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (interaction_vertices_card n))
    _ = _ := by rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega

name: Erdos278.prime_dp_sparse_bounds
statement:
theorem prime_dp_sparse_bounds {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) :
    (primeDP n).card ≤ 2 ^ (interactionPairs n).card ∧
    finiteSeparationCandidateCount (fun c : RadixCoordinate (inputPrimeExponents n) =>
      localSeparationMasks (radixSupport (inputPrimeExponents n) c)
        (inputPrimeRadix n c.1)) ≤
      (∑ i, Nat.clog 2 (n i)) * 2 ^ (2 * (interactionPairs n).card) ∧
    (primeDP n ×ˢ (interactionVertices n).powerset).card ≤
      2 ^ (3 * (interactionPairs n).card)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (primeDP n).card ≤ 2 ^ (interactionPairs n).card :=
    radix_dp_sparse_state_bound n _ _ (fun p => (input_radix_prime n p).two_le)
      (input_radix_representation n hn)
  refine ⟨hs, ?_, sparse_objective_candidate_bound n _ hs⟩
  exact (radix_dp_sparse_candidate_bound n _ _ (fun p => (input_radix_prime n p).two_le)
    (input_radix_representation n hn)).trans
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (prime_dp_coordinate_bound n hn))

proof:

name: Erdos278.example_interaction

name: Erdos278.example_density
statement: theorem example_density : density univ exampleModuli exampleResidues = 11 / 15

name: Erdos278.example_compressed_bound

theorem example_compressed_bound (a : Fin 3 → Fin 2) :

name: Erdos278.example_global_maximum
statement:
theorem example_global_maximum :
    density univ exampleModuli exampleResidues = 11 / 15 ∧
      ∀ a : Fin 3 → ℤ, density univ exampleModuli a ≤ 11 / 15
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨example_density, fun a => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := canonical_representatives (fun _ : Fin 3 => 2) (by decide) a
  have heq : density univ exampleModuli (fun i => (b i : ℤ)) =
      density univ exampleModuli a := by
    apply density_eq_of_compatible univ exampleModuli
      (fun i _ => example_moduli_positive i)
    apply interaction_compression
    intro i
    rw [example_interaction, hb i]
    exact Int.mod_modEq _ _
  rw [← heq]
  exact example_compressed_bound b

name: Erdos278.impossible_empty_graph_value
statement:
theorem impossible_empty_graph_value :
    (1 : ℚ)/2 + 1/6 + 1/10 = 23/30 ∧ (11 : ℚ)/15 < 23/30
proof: := by norm_num

name: Erdos278.common_gcd_density_depends_on_partition
statement:
theorem common_gcd_density_depends_on_partition (n : ι → ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) (g : ℕ)
    (hg : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → (n i).gcd (n j) = g)
    (a b : ι → ℤ) (hp : ∀ i, a i ≡ b i [ZMOD g]) :
    density univ n a = density univ n b
proof:
:= by
  apply density_eq_of_compatible univ n (fun i _ => hn i)
  intro i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j; simp [Compatible]
  · unfold Compatible
    rw [hg i j hij]
    exact ⟨fun h => (hp i).symm.trans (h.trans (hp j)),
      fun h => (hp i).trans (h.trans (hp j).symm)⟩

name: Erdos278.common_gcd_partition_optimization
statement:
theorem common_gcd_partition_optimization (n : ι → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (g : ℕ) (hg0 : 0 < g) (hg : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → (n i).gcd (n j) = g) (d : ℚ) :
    (∃ a : ι → ℤ, density univ n a = d) ↔
      ∃ part : ι → Fin g, density univ n (fun i => (part i : ℤ)) = d
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨part, hp⟩ := canonical_representatives (fun _ : ι => g) (fun _ => hg0) a
    refine ⟨part, common_gcd_density_depends_on_partition n hn g hg _ a ?_⟩
    intro i
    rw [hp i]
    exact Int.mod_modEq _ _
  · rintro ⟨part, hp⟩
    exact ⟨fun i => (part i : ℤ), hp⟩

name: Erdos278.common_gcd_factors_coprime
statement:
theorem common_gcd_factors_coprime (g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) (b : ι → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → (g * b i).gcd (g * b j) = g) :
    ∀ i j, i ≠ j → (b i).Coprime (b j)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have heq := h i j hij
  rw [Nat.gcd_mul_left] at heq
  apply Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.mpr
  nlinarith

name: Erdos278.common_gcd_need_not_be_coprime_to_factors
statement:
theorem common_gcd_need_not_be_coprime_to_factors :
    Nat.gcd 4 6 = 2 ∧ Nat.Coprime 2 3 ∧ ¬Nat.Coprime 2 2
proof: := by decide

name: Erdos278.twice_pair_count
statement:
theorem twice_pair_count (r : ℕ) :
    2 * Fintype.card (PairIndex r) = r * (r - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_congr (pairIndexEquiv r), Fintype.card_sigma]
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
  have hsum : (∑ j : Fin r, j.val) = ∑ j ∈ range r, j :=
    Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j : ℕ => j) r
  rw [hsum, Nat.mul_comm 2]
  exact Finset.sum_range_id_mul_two r

name: Erdos278.integer_variable_count
statement:
theorem integer_variable_count {r : ℕ} (i₀ : Fin r) :
    ((univ : Finset (Fin r)).erase i₀).card +
      Fintype.card (PairIndex r) + Fintype.card (PairIndex r) = r^2 - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le i₀.val) i₀.isLt
  have hp := twice_pair_count r
  simp only [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (mem_univ i₀), Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hm : r - 1 + 1 = r := by omega
  have hsq : 1 ≤ r^2 := by nlinarith
  have hsqeq : r^2 - 1 + 1 = r^2 := Nat.sub_add_cancel hsq
  nlinarith

name: Erdos278.interacting_vertices_bound
statement:
theorem interacting_vertices_bound {r : ℕ} (edges : Finset (PairIndex r)) :
    (edges.biUnion (fun e => {e.1.1, e.1.2})).card ≤ 2 * edges.card
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ e ∈ edges, ({e.1.1, e.1.2} : Finset (Fin r)).card := Finset.card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ _e ∈ edges, 2 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun e _ => by
      have hne : e.1.1 ≠ e.1.2 := ne_of_lt e.2
      simp [hne])
    _ = 2 * edges.card := by simp [Nat.mul_comm]

name: Erdos278.objective_coefficients_integral
statement:
theorem objective_coefficients_integral {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) (S : CliqueIndex r) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, (((univ : Finset (Fin r)).lcm n : ℕ) : ℚ) *
      ((-1 : ℚ) ^ (S.1.card + 1) / (S.1.lcm n : ℕ)) = k
proof:
:= by
  have hdiv : S.1.lcm n ∣ (univ : Finset (Fin r)).lcm n :=
    Finset.lcm_mono (subset_univ _)
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdiv
  have hnonzero : ((S.1.lcm n : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Finset.lcm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => (hn i).ne')
  refine ⟨(-1 : ℤ) ^ (S.1.card + 1) * k, ?_⟩
  rw [hk]
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: Erdos278.model_maximum_attained
statement:
theorem model_maximum_attained {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) (i₀ : Fin r) :
    ∃ x q y z, ModelFeasible n i₀ x q y z ∧
      (∀ a, (density univ n a : ℝ) ≤ modelObjective n z) ∧
      (∀ x' q' y' z', ModelFeasible n i₀ x' q' y' z' →
        modelObjective n z' ≤ modelObjective n z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := maximum_attained n hn
  obtain ⟨x, q, y, z, hf, hz⟩ := model_complete n hn i₀ a
  refine ⟨x, q, y, z, hf, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro b
    rw [hz]
    exact_mod_cast ha b
  · intro x' q' y' z' hf'
    rw [model_objective_correct n hn i₀ x' q' y' z' hf', hz]
    exact_mod_cast ha x'

name: Erdos278.verified_maximum_density
statement:
theorem verified_maximum_density {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) (i₀ : Fin r) :
    ∃ (a : Fin r → ℤ) (q y : PairIndex r → ℤ) (z : CliqueIndex r → ℝ) (d : ℚ),
      ModelFeasible n i₀ a q y z ∧
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (Nat.count (CoveredNat univ n a) N : ℝ) / N)
        atTop (𝓝 (d : ℝ)) ∧
      d = graphValue univ n (Compatible n a) ∧
      modelObjective n z = (d : ℝ) ∧
      (∀ b : Fin r → ℤ, density univ n b ≤ d) ∧
      (∀ a' q' y' z', ModelFeasible n i₀ a' q' y' z' →
        modelObjective n z' ≤ (d : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, q, y, z, hf, hmax, hmodelmax⟩ := model_maximum_attained n hn i₀
  have heq := model_objective_correct n hn i₀ a q y z hf
  refine ⟨a, q, y, z, density univ n a, hf,
    density_is_natural_density univ n (fun i _ => hn i) a,
    density_eq_graphValue univ n (fun i _ => hn i) a, heq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro b
    have h := hmax b
    rw [heq] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  · intro a' q' y' z' hf'
    rw [← heq]
    exact hmodelmax a' q' y' z' hf'

name: Erdos278.prescribed_pair_exact
statement:
theorem prescribed_pair_exact (d t : ℤ) (hd : 0 < d) (edge : Bool) :
    (∃ q, prescribedPair d t q edge) ↔ (edge = true ↔ d ∣ t)
proof:
:= by
  cases edge with
  | false =>
    simp only [prescribedPair, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, false_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨q, hlo, hhi⟩ ht
      have hdiv : d ∣ t - d * q := dvd_sub ht (dvd_mul_right d q)
      have hpos : 0 < t - d * q := by omega
      have := Int.le_of_dvd hpos hdiv
      omega
    · intro ht
      refine ⟨t / d, ?_⟩
      have hnonneg := Int.emod_nonneg t hd.ne'
      have hlt := Int.emod_lt_of_pos t hd
      have hne : t % d ≠ 0 := mt Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero ht
      have hrem := Int.emod_add_mul_ediv t d
      omega
  | true =>
    simp only [prescribedPair, ↓reduceIte, true_iff]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨q, h⟩ => ⟨q, h⟩, fun ⟨q, h⟩ => ⟨q, h⟩⟩

name: Erdos278.fixed_graph_feasible_iff
statement:
theorem fixed_graph_feasible_iff {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) (i₀ : Fin r) (G : PairIndex r → Bool) :
    (∃ a : Fin r → ℤ, ∀ e, G e = true ↔ Compatible n a e.1.1 e.1.2) ↔
      ∃ x q, FixedGraphFeasible n i₀ G x q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    let x : Fin r → ℤ := fun i => (a i - a i₀) % n i
    have hx (i j : Fin r) : Compatible n x i j ↔ Compatible n a i j :=
      (reduce_preserves_compatibility n (fun i => a i - a i₀) i j).trans
        (translate_preserves_compatibility n a (a i₀) i j)
    have hq (e : PairIndex r) : ∃ q, prescribedPair
        ((n e.1.1).gcd (n e.1.2)) (x e.1.1 - x e.1.2) q (G e) := by
      apply (prescribed_pair_exact _ _ (by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left (n e.1.2) (hn e.1.1)) _).mpr
      exact ((ha e).trans (hx e.1.1 e.1.2).symm).trans
        (compatible_iff_dvd n x e.1.1 e.1.2)
    classical
    refine ⟨x, fun e => Classical.choose (hq e), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [x]
    · intro i
      have hp : (0 : ℤ) < n i := by exact_mod_cast hn i
      exact ⟨Int.emod_nonneg _ hp.ne', Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ hp⟩
    · exact fun e => Classical.choose_spec (hq e)
  · rintro ⟨x, q, _, _, hq⟩
    refine ⟨x, fun e => ?_⟩
    have h := (prescribed_pair_exact _ _ (by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left (n e.1.2) (hn e.1.1)) (G e)).mp
        ⟨q e, hq e⟩
    exact h.trans (compatible_iff_dvd n x e.1.1 e.1.2).symm

name: Erdos278.fixed_graph_integer_count
statement:
theorem fixed_graph_integer_count {r : ℕ} (i₀ : Fin r) :
    ((univ : Finset (Fin r)).erase i₀).card + Fintype.card (PairIndex r) =
      r - 1 + r * (r - 1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hp := twice_pair_count r
  simp only [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (mem_univ i₀), Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  omega

name: Erdos278.interaction_eq_gcd_pair_period
statement:
theorem interaction_eq_gcd_pair_period {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) (i : Fin r) :
    interactionModulus n i = (n i).gcd (pairGCDPeriod n)
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.dvd_antisymm
  · apply Nat.dvd_gcd (interaction_dvd_modulus n i)
    apply Finset.lcm_dvd
    intro j hj
    have hji : j ≠ i := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1
    rcases lt_trichotomy i j with hij | hij | hji'
    · exact Finset.dvd_lcm (f := fun e : PairIndex r => (n e.1.1).gcd (n e.1.2))
        (Finset.mem_univ (⟨(i, j), hij⟩ : PairIndex r))
    · exact (hji hij.symm).elim
    · have h := Finset.dvd_lcm (f := fun e : PairIndex r => (n e.1.1).gcd (n e.1.2))
        (Finset.mem_univ (⟨(j, i), hji'⟩ : PairIndex r))
      simpa only [pairGCDPeriod, Nat.gcd_comm] using h
  · rw [pairGCDPeriod, gcd_finset_lcm univ
      (fun e : PairIndex r => (n e.1.1).gcd (n e.1.2)) (n i) (hn i).ne'
      (fun e _ => (Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left (n e.1.2) (hn e.1.1)).ne')]
    apply Finset.lcm_dvd
    intro e _
    by_cases hi : e.1.1 = i
    · have hji : e.1.2 ≠ i := by
        intro hj
        have hlt := e.2
        simp [hi, hj] at hlt
      have hd : (n i).gcd ((n e.1.1).gcd (n e.1.2)) ∣ (n i).gcd (n e.1.2) :=
        Nat.dvd_gcd (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)
          ((Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _).trans (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _))
      exact hd.trans (gcd_dvd_interaction n hji)
    · have hd : (n i).gcd ((n e.1.1).gcd (n e.1.2)) ∣ (n i).gcd (n e.1.1) :=
        Nat.dvd_gcd (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)
          ((Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _).trans (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _))
      exact hd.trans (gcd_dvd_interaction n hi)
